title: Senior Data Engineer – Snowflake & Dbt
description:
Job Description

**Open Position:** Senior Data Engineer – Snowflake & Dbt

**Company:** Bilight Solutions LLP  
**Location:** Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Permanent  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Shift:** Australian Shift (Sydney/Melbourne Time Zone)  
**Compensation:** Based on interview performance

About Bilight Solutions

Bilight Solutions is a fast-growing Business Intelligence and Data Analytics company specializing in transforming raw data into actionable business insights through AI-driven data solutions. We deliver innovative BI, analytics, and data engineering solutions that empower organizations to make informed business decisions.

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Data Engineer – Snowflake & dbt** to join our growing Data Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and Azure data services, with hands-on experience in enterprise data warehouse development, migration, and consolidation initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain ELT pipelines to ingest data into Snowflake from Azure Synapse, on-premises SQL Server, and enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain dbt models across staging, intermediate, and mart layers.
* Apply dimensional modeling practices and establish consistent business definitions across integrated data sources.
* Support the migration and consolidation of existing Azure Synapse and SQL Server workloads into Snowflake.
* Refactor transformation logic, reconcile outputs, and validate data against legacy reports.
* Build and manage data orchestration workflows using Azure Data Factory, dbt scheduling, and Snowflake-native capabilities.
* Deliver curated, well-documented datasets and semantic models to support Power BI reporting.
* Prepare trusted, AI-ready datasets to support enterprise AI initiatives.
* Implement data quality tests, documentation, and lineage using dbt.
* Contribute to data governance, role-based access control, and Snowflake performance and cost optimization.
* Follow Git-based version control, code review, and CI/CD practices.
* Collaborate with data, analytics, and architecture teams and maintain clear technical documentation.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, including warehouse design, RBAC, performance tuning, and cost optimization.
* Experience with dbt Core and/or dbt Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of dimensional modeling, preferably Kimball methodology.
* Advanced SQL skills, including T-SQL and Snowflake SQL.
* Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory and data orchestration.
* Understanding of Microsoft Azure services, including storage, networking, and security fundamentals.
* Experience working with Power BI datasets and semantic models.
* Proficiency in Git, CI/CD, and version control practices.
* Understanding of data quality frameworks, data lineage, and access controls.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

**Experience & Eligibility**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience delivering production workloads using Snowflake and dbt.
* Demonstrated experience migrating data warehouse workloads from Azure Synapse and/or SQL Server to Snowflake.
* Experience building enterprise data models integrating multiple source systems.
* Exposure to healthcare, aged care, financial services, or other regulated industries is an added advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with international stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* Python programming experience.
* Exposure to Azure OpenAI or enterprise AI-ready data solutions.
* Experience working with Australian stakeholders.
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, and responsible data management practices.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification.
* Snowflake SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer.
* Dbt Analytics Engineering Certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700).
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203).
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Paid Sick Leave
* Professional Growth and Learning Opportunities
* Exposure to Enterprise-Level Data Engineering Projects
* Collaborative and Employee-Friendly Work Environment

**Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at:**

**Email:** talentacquisition@bilightsolutions.com

**Work Location:** Chennai (Work from Office)

Work Location: In person

title: Data Modeler - Insurance – Life & Annuities and Property & Casualty
description:
# DLTJP00062532 – Data Modeler

\*\*Experience:\*\* 8–10 Years

\*\*Number of Positions:\*\* 3

\*\*Work Location:\*\* Hyderabad / Bangalore / Chennai / Pune

\*\*Budget:\*\* Up to 30 LPA

\*\*Work Mode:\*\* Hybrid

\*\*Work Timings:\*\* 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM

\*\*Interview Rounds:\*\* 1 Internal Virtual + 1 Internal In-Person + 1 Client Virtual

\*\*Interview Mode:\*\* Virtual + Face-to-Face

\*\*Final Round:\*\* Face-to-Face

\*\*Domain:\*\* Insurance – Life & Annuities and Property & Casualty

\*\*Maximum Rate:\*\* Senior – ₹2,300/hour; Junior – ₹1,700/hour

---

## Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Data Modeler with strong insurance domain knowledge to design, develop, and maintain enterprise data models. The role involves working directly with business and client stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable data models aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

## Key Responsibilities

- Engage directly with business and client stakeholders to understand business requirements and data needs, translating them into scalable enterprise data models.

- Design, develop, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for Insurance, including Life & Annuities and Property & Casualty domains.

- Collaborate with business analysts, architects, developers, and data engineers to align data models with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.

- Develop subject area models, data dictionaries, metadata, and data lineage documentation.

- Apply data modeling best practices, naming standards, governance principles, and modeling methodologies.

- Support data warehouse, reporting, analytics, and operational system initiatives through robust data model design.

- Perform data analysis, source-to-target mapping, and data profiling to support model development and data integration.

- Review and optimize existing data models for performance, scalability, and maintainability.

- Participate in data governance initiatives and ensure consistency across enterprise data assets.

## Mandatory Skills and Qualifications

- 8–10 years of experience in Data Modeling, Data Architecture, or related data management roles.

- Strong expertise in the Insurance domain, including:

- \*\*Life & Annuities:\*\* Policy Administration, Claims, Billing, Underwriting, Customer, and Financials.

- \*\*Property & Casualty:\*\* Policy, Claims, Risk, Coverage, Premiums, and Reinsurance.

- Hands-on experience with ERwin Data Modeler or other leading data modeling tools such as ER/Studio, PowerDesigner, SAP PowerDesigner, or Enterprise Architect.

- Strong knowledge of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling techniques.

- Expertise in OLTP and OLAP data model design principles.

- In-depth understanding of normalization, denormalization, and Normal Forms (1NF through 5NF).

- Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, including:

- Star Schema

- Snowflake Schema

- Fact and Dimension Modeling

- Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Types 1, 2, and 3)

- Experience creating enterprise data models, canonical data models, and integration data models.

- Strong SQL skills and ability to analyze complex data structures across multiple source systems.

- Understanding of data governance, metadata management, Master Data Management (MDM), and data quality concepts.

## Good-to-Have Skills and Qualifications

- Experience with cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or Google Cloud.

- Knowledge of insurance industry data standards

Pay: Up to ₹3,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Databricks Platform Administrator
description:
**Job Family****:**

Database Administration (India)

**What You Will Do****:**

We’re seeking an experienced Databricks Platform Administrator to manage and improve our enterprise data platform. You’ll help keep the environment secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective, working closely with data engineering, data science, development, security, and cloud infrastructure teams.

The ideal candidate has at least four years of experience in cloud platforms, data engineering infrastructure, platform administration, or a related field, including hands-on experience administering Databricks in an enterprise environment. This is a non-people manager role. All hands-on.  
**What You Will Need****:**

**1.0 Key Responsibilities**

* Administer Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, notebooks, instance pools, SQL warehouses, and related services.
* Manage users, groups, roles, service principals, permissions, credentials, and access controls.
* Apply security and governance standards using Unity Catalog, role-based access controls, and data-governance policies.
* Monitor platform availability, system health, job execution, cluster performance, and resource usage.
* Troubleshoot failed jobs, cluster and connectivity issues, performance bottlenecks, and access incidents.
* Configure clusters, pools, autoscaling, and compute policies to improve performance and manage costs.
* Support Databricks integrations with cloud storage, databases, business intelligence tools, APIs, and enterprise applications.
* Maintain configurations across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
* Support automated deployment and infrastructure management through CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
* Build and maintain monitoring dashboards, alerts, audit reports, and operational documentation.
* Coordinate platform upgrades, configuration changes, testing, and releases.
* Partner with cybersecurity and governance teams on audits, compliance, logging, and data protection.
* Assist with establishing platform standards, administrative procedures, naming conventions, and operational practices.
* Provide technical guidance to data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and application teams.
* Assess platform usage and recommend improvements to scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.

**1.0 Required Qualifications**

* At least four years of experience in cloud infrastructure, data platform administration, database administration, DevOps, data engineering, or a related technical field.
* Hands-on experience administering Databricks in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with Azure Databricks is a must and Databricks on AWS is a nice to have.
* Strong knowledge of Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, notebooks, SQL warehouses, instance pools, and compute policies.
* Experience with Unity Catalog, identity management, service principals, secrets, access controls, and data governance.
* Experience monitoring and troubleshooting Databricks jobs, clusters, integrations, and platform performance.
* Experience with cloud storage, networking, security, and identity-management services.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language, such as Python or PowerShell
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Experience integrating Databricks with Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake, SQL Server, or other enterprise data platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

**What Would Be Nice To Have****:**

  

**1.0 Preferred Qualifications**

* Databricks certification, such as Databricks Certified Data Engineer or Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark.
* Certification in Microsoft Azure
* Experience with Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, MLflow, Lakehouse architecture, or Databricks SQL.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Experience supporting regulated, federal, healthcare, financial services, or other highly controlled environments.
* Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage, audit logging, disaster recovery, and business-continuity planning.

**2.0 Key Skills**

Databricks administration; Unity Catalog; cloud infrastructure; cluster management; performance and cost optimization; platform security; identity and access management; CI/CD; Infrastructure as Code; Python; SQL; Terraform; monitoring; troubleshooting; data governance; technical documentation.

title: Microsoft Purview SME _Security Specialist
description:
Job Description

Microsoft Purview SME \_Security Specialist

Job Location: Chennai, Noida, Pune

Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country

Req Id: 14020

Posting Start Date: 10/29/26

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.

With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

**Responsibilities**

The Microsoft Purview SME will be responsible for the implementation, administration, monitoring, and operational management of Microsoft Purview solutions. The role includes managing information protection, data loss prevention, data lifecycle management, records management, eDiscovery, insider risk, and compliance capabilities to ensure organizational data remains protected and governed according to business, security, and regulatory requirements.

  

**Roles and responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and administer Microsoft Purview solutions in accordance with organizational security, compliance, and data governance requirements.
* Design, configure, and maintain sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption settings, and protection controls across Microsoft 365 services.
* Implement and manage manual, recommended, and automatic data classification and labeling capabilities.
* Configure and maintain Data Loss Prevention policies across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 applications, and managed endpoints.
* Monitor and investigate DLP alerts, policy matches, data leakage incidents, and user-reported data protection concerns.
* Analyze false-positive and false-negative DLP detections and perform policy optimization and tuning.
* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management, including retention policies and retention labels.
* Support Records Management requirements, including regulatory records, event-based retention, disposition reviews, and proof of disposition.
* Configure and support Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Standard and Premium capabilities.
* Assist Legal, Compliance, HR, and Security teams with legal holds, content searches, collections, review sets, investigations, and evidence exports.
* Configure and maintain Insider Risk Management policies, indicators, alerts, and investigation workflows.
* Support Communication Compliance policies and investigations in coordination with authorized business stakeholders.
* Manage Microsoft Purview Audit capabilities and assist with audit log searches, compliance investigations, and evidence collection.
* Develop and maintain data classification schemas, sensitive information types, trainable classifiers, exact data match configurations, and keyword dictionaries.
* Support Microsoft Purview Data Map and Data Catalog capabilities where included within the organizational data governance scope.
* Perform periodic reviews of Microsoft Purview configurations, policies, alerts, incidents, and compliance posture.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft Purview policy behavior, configuration issues, service limitations, and integration-related problems.
* Support integrations between Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Sentinel, and other security monitoring platforms.
* Collaborate with Security Operations Center, Legal, Compliance, Risk, HR, Messaging, Workplace, Infrastructure, and End User Support teams to resolve information protection and compliance-related issues.
* Coordinate with Microsoft Vendor Support for product defects, technical limitations, and complex service-related incidents.
* Generate operational reports, compliance dashboards, security metrics, policy effectiveness reports, and trend analysis for management and customer review.
* Participate in compliance assessments, security audits, service reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Translate business, legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements into appropriate Microsoft Purview technical controls.
* Maintain operational documentation, high-level designs, low-level designs, standard operating procedures, implementation standards, support runbooks, and knowledge base articles.
* Provide L3 technical support and subject matter expertise for Microsoft Purview-related incidents, service requests, changes, and projects.
* Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to operational and support teams.
  

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Security, or a related field.
* 5 to 7 years of experience in Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Compliance, Information Protection, Data Governance, or related technologies.
* At least 3 years of hands-on experience implementing or administering Microsoft Purview solutions.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Purview Information Protection, including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto-labeling, and data classification.
* Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and tuning Data Loss Prevention policies across Microsoft 365 workloads and managed endpoints.
* Experience managing retention policies, retention labels, Data Lifecycle Management, Records Management, and disposition processes.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Standard or Premium, including legal holds, collections, content searches, review sets, and evidence exports.
* Experience configuring or supporting Insider Risk Management and Communication Compliance solutions.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview Audit and audit log investigation capabilities.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft 365 applications.
* Experience creating and managing sensitive information types, trainable classifiers, exact data match configurations, and data classification schemas.
* Understanding of information protection, data privacy, data governance, records management, regulatory compliance, and legal discovery requirements.
* Experience integrating Microsoft Purview capabilities with Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM, or security monitoring platforms.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, KQL, and Microsoft 365 administrative tools.
* Experience in incident management, change management, service request fulfilment, root-cause analysis, and technical problem resolution.
* Experience working with Legal, Compliance, Risk, HR, Security Operations, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to translate compliance and business requirements into scalable technical controls.
* Experience producing technical designs, governance standards, operational reports, SOPs, runbooks, and audit evidence.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview licensing, role-based access control, administrative roles, and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, stakeholder-management, communication, and documentation skills.
  

**Preferred Certifications:**

* Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate (SC-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)

Relocation Supported: Yes

Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

title: Senior Application Support Engineer
description:
Location:
Chennai, IN, 600113

Requisition ID: 19669

**Your growth matters.**

  

At IGT, we're building a culture where people Innovate with Purpose, Compete Intensely & Win, Lead with Heart, Make It Matter, and Create Value. Grow your career while helping shape what's next.

  

Build what's next at IGT.

**Role Overvie**

  

As a Senior Application Support Engineer (Level 5), you are the most senior technical authority below management within L3 RGS Global Operations — a hands-on specialist who resolves the most complex, code-level issues across the IGT RGS platform. You sit within a dedicated subject-matter-expert (SME) team that goes deeper than generalist application support, and you are expected to own a defined area of the product at genuine expert level.
  
This role exists because the platform’s architectural, integration and delivery complexity now demands engineers who can investigate at a code level — reading and reasoning about the application’s behaviour directly, not just its symptoms — and who can work shoulder to shoulder with core platform engineering on the most complex faults. Your development background is central to the role: the same skills used to build adapters, integrations and customisations are exactly what allow you to debug them precisely under production conditions.
  
You will act as the escalation destination for incidents the generalist L3 teams cannot resolve, partner directly with engineering to drive permanent fixes, and raise the technical quality of the wider support organisation through the evidence, tooling and documentation you produce — in a microservices-based, multi-vendor, globally distributed environment.
  
You will assist with operational delivery of new features and functionality across promotional tools, game engines and core functionality. Working with the wider operational teams and directly with product management and engineering you will ensure new features meet operational requirements and wider operational teams are ready to adapt and implement and support these features.

**What You’ll Do**

* Serve as the technical SME for one or more core product domains, including promotional tools, core platform functionality, game engines, integration layers, and customizations.
* Independently diagnose and resolve complex, multi-system issues across application,integration, platform, and data layers, including code-level investigation across Java back-end and JavaScript/HTML front-end applications and event flows.
* Act as a senior escalation point for incidents that exceed generalist L3 support capabilities by forming and testing hypotheses, analyzing technical evidence, and isolating root causes under production conditions.
* Partner directly with core platform engineering to reproduce complex issues, identify failing components, provide complete and reproducible technical context, and validate permanent fixes.
* Trace and analyze API and integration flows using application code, technical documentation, and flow diagrams. Build or enhance scripts, queries, and diagnostic tools as needed to improve investigation and resolution.
* Perform log-driven investigations using OpenSearch/DQL or similar technologies and leverage platform data to support incident analysis, decision-making, and technical solutions.
* Lead root-cause analysis and problem-management activities, partnering with engineering to define corrective actions and reduce issue recurrence, customer impact, and mean time to resolution (MTTR).
* Create and maintain specialist runbooks, debugging playbooks, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and diagnostic tools to improve the consistency and efficiency of technical support.
* Mentor and support other technical support engineers through case reviews, technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and coaching on investigation methodologies.
* Support operational readiness for new features, functionality, integrations, markets, migrations, and platform changes by validating expected behavior, identifying operational risks, and supporting successful rollout and handover.
* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and wider operational teams to support the delivery of new functionality across promotional tools, game engines, and core platform capabilities.
* Maintain a high level of technical ownership within assigned product domains and promote continuous improvement across the support organization.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**Experience Required**
=======================

* 10 years of work related experience is required.
* Extensive hands-on experience in senior technical application support, software engineering, integration/delivery, or a related technical role supporting business-critical, customer-facing platforms.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing complex issues across distributed, multi-system environments, including application, integration, platform, and data layers.
* Experience investigating application behavior at the code level and isolating and validating technical fixes in production environments.
* Experience with API and system integrations and the ability to determine system behavior using application code, technical documentation, and flow diagrams.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and supporting incident and problem-management processes.

**Skills Required**
===================

* Strong development-level proficiency with **Java** for back-end applications.
* Strong knowledge of **JavaScript and HTML**, including the ability to understand and debug front-end application and event flows.
* Strong understanding of APIs and integration flows. Experience designing, developing, or extending APIs is a plus.
* Strong Linux server knowledge and scripting skills, including the ability to develop or adapt diagnostic tools.
* Experience with log-driven troubleshooting and analysis; knowledge of **OpenSearch, DQL, or equivalent query tools** is preferred.
* Ability to use technical and operational data effectively when investigating incidents and determining solutions.

title: Robotics Engineering Intern — Limitless Robotics
description:
**Robotics Engineering Intern — Limitless Robotics**

Limitless Robotics Private Limited, Chennai, invites applications for the position of Robotics Engineering Intern. The successful candidate will work directly with the founder on the design, assembly, programming and testing of robotic hardware.

This position is not defined by a list of programming languages or tools. Technical skills are taught on the job. The company is seeking candidates with strong engineering fundamentals, demonstrated hands-on ability, and a strong commitment to learning and building in a hardware start-up environment.

The company's current engineers joined with fundamentals and commitment, and were trained through direct mentorship and AI-assisted development. Within months they were performing work that typically requires several years of industry experience. The same accelerated path is offered to this position.

**About the work**

Limitless Robotics develops robotic hardware for people who need it. Technical details of the product are not disclosed in public postings. Full details are shared with candidates who reach the practical assessment stage.

**Hard skills**

1. Engineering fundamentals: basic circuit theory (voltage, current, power, Ohm's law), basic mechanics (force, torque, moments) and basic programming competence in any language (Python, C, C++, Java or equivalent).

2. At least one completed hands-on project using a microcontroller platform such as Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Teensy or Raspberry Pi.

3. Working familiarity with hand tools, including drill, hacksaw, file, soldering iron and multimeter.

4. Ability to read a datasheet and a schematic with guidance.

Taught during the internship (listed so that applicants understand the scope of training):

5. Embedded C/C++ for real-time motor and sensor control.

6. Python for data logging, analysis and plotting (pandas, matplotlib).

7. BLDC motor control: PWM, PID loops, current, velocity and position control, torque control, FOC fundamentals and motor driver integration.

8. Communication buses: CAN, CAN FD, UART, SPI and I2C.

9. Sensors: IMUs, encoders, strain gauges and current sensing.

10. Power electronics: battery and bus management.

11. Mechanical fabrication and prototyping: aluminium machining, bolted joints, fits and tolerances, CAD (Fusion 360, SolidWorks or FreeCAD) and basic FEA.

12. Control fundamentals: gravity compensation, impedance and admittance control, state machines and safety supervisors.

13. Version control (Git), test protocols and engineering documentation.

14. ROS 2 where applicable.

15. AI-assisted engineering: use of tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot to accelerate development, with rigorous verification of all generated code against physical hardware.

**Soft skills**

**Perseverance:** The patience to work through repeated setbacks until a system functions correctly.

**Ownership:** The initiative to take a problem and a workbench and proceed without waiting for daily task assignment.

**Integrity:** Prompt and open reporting of mistakes and gaps in understanding, since hardware problems are far easier to resolve when raised early.

**Rapid learning:** The ability to become productive from a single explanation, a datasheet or a guided AI session.

**Resilience:** The capacity to recover from failed boards, damaged drivers and delayed components, including sourcing replacements locally from Ritchie Street or Ambattur.

**Communication:** Concise, clear technical writing. The ability to explain what was done and why in a few lines.

**Safety orientation:** Care in handling equipment that is costly and, in its final form, intended for use by people.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Assemble robotic prototypes from components through to functional motion.

2. Develop embedded code for motors and sensors, with AI assistance, and validate it on physical hardware.

3. Conduct bench tests, log and plot data, and interpret the results.

4. Fabricate and modify mechanical components as required, sourcing materials from Ritchie Street, Ambattur, Robu.in and other suppliers.

5. Diagnose and resolve hardware and software faults, and document the root cause.

6. Assume ownership of a subsystem within the first month.

**Career significance**

Many robotics graduates complete their education without having controlled a motor under load, wired a CAN bus, machined a load-bearing component or debugged firmware on hardware of significant value. A substantial number spend their first three to five years in roles that do not provide these opportunities.

This position provides end-to-end exposure within the first year: electronics, embedded firmware, motor control, mechanical build, testing and documentation, on a product under active development. This breadth of hardware experience is scarce and highly valued by robotics employers in India and internationally. It also forms a sound foundation for candidates who intend to establish their own hardware ventures.

The intern will conclude the engagement with a portfolio of working systems, a professional reference from the founder who supervised the work, and the practical judgement that is acquired only through building, breaking and repairing real hardware.

**What the company offers**

1. Direct, daily mentorship from the founder.

2. Genuine ownership of subsystems on a real product.

3. A founding-stage role in the company as it scales.

**Qualifications**

Pursuing or having completed a degree or diploma in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Mechanical, Biomedical or Computer Science Engineering.Final-year students, recent graduates and career-switchers with a demonstrable hardware portfolio are eligible.

**Location:** Chennai, on-site, as the work is hardware-based.

**Duration:** 3 to 6 months, extendable to full-time employment.

**Self-assessment**

This role asks a great deal and offers a great deal in return. Applicants are invited to consider each statement below honestly. Those who can affirm all six are encouraged to apply; those who cannot may find that a different role suits their circumstances better, and that is entirely reasonable.

1. I want to do excellent work and I am prepared to put in the effort it requires.

2. I will work on-site in Chennai, with the hardware, on most working days.

3. I am comfortable receiving direct feedback and acting on it.

4. I value depth of experience over comfort at this stage of my career.

5. I have built a physical system that worked and can provide evidence of it.

6. .I am seeking substantive engineering experience rather than a certificate alone.

**Application procedure**

Applications should be sent by email to **hr@zgrowsolutions.com** or **contact@zgrowsolutions.com** include:

1. A description, in approximately five lines, of the most complex system the applicant has built or repaired, what failed, and how it was resolved.

2. Supporting evidence: photographs, video, code repositories or equivalent.

3. A statement, in approximately three lines, of why the applicant is seeking this position rather than a conventional internship.

4. Earliest available start date.

A resume is optional. A cover letter is not required. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a half-day practical assessment at the workshop, in which they will wire a motor, bring it into motion and explain their observations. Candidates are informed of the outcome promptly after the assessment.

Job Types: Full-time, Internship

Application Question(s):

* Are you available to join immediately? If not, please mention your availability.
* Do you have any prior internship, freelance, or project experience in Digital Marketing? If yes, please briefly describe it.

Work Location: In person

description:
**Java Full Stack Developer with Backend Focus**
------------------------------------------------

**Role**

Java Full Stack Developer — Backend Focus

**Grade**

Assistant Vice President

**Location**

Mumbai

**Reports To**

TBC

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
-------------------------------------

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

**Position Purpose**
--------------------

Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable Java-based backend services and middle business layer components within enterprise full-stack applications. Own backend architecture decisions, API design, data access patterns, and integration with upstream and downstream systems. Work competently across the existing frontend layer using Angular/TypeScript/React**.** Bring the depth of an experienced backend engineer with the breadth to contribute across the full stack. Leverage AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of day-to-day engineering practice.

**Direct Responsibilities**
---------------------------

* Design and Develop scalable full-stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular).

* Design and optimize high-performance APIs with security, caching, and fault tolerance.

* Design and Develop robust backend services with efficient database interactions.

* Build responsive UI with seamless backend integration.

* Automate CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable software delivery.

* Lead cloud-native deployments with containerization, auto-scaling, and cost optimization.

* Enforce Quality-first engineering: Unit, integration, and ensure high code quality with SonarQube.

* Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and drive technical excellence across the team.

* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into robust, compliant technical solutions.

**Contributing Responsibilities**
---------------------------------

* Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions, particularly around API design, data layer, and system integration

* Participate in code reviews and enforce clean code and quality gate standards

* Support knowledge transfer and capability building within the India Solutions team

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, QA, infrastructure) on integration and delivery

* Improving DevSecOps maturity and SDLC practices within the team

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
---------------------------------------

* **Autonomy & Ownership**: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* **Industry Expertise**: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* **Collaboration & Communication**: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
---------------------------

**Experience Level: 8+ years**

* 7+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale

* 5+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments

* Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills.

* Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React

* Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture

* Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow

**Domain Experience**

* Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred

* Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous

* Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

**Required:**

**Skill Group**

**Details**

**Core Java & JDK 21+**

1. **Modern language features** – records, sealed classes, pattern‑matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional).
  
2. **Concurrency & Parallelism** – virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives.
  
3. **JVM & GC tuning** – G1/ZGC behaviour, heap‑dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module‑system (JPMS) usage.

4. Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling
  
5. **Build & Unit‑test foundation** – Maven/Gradle multi‑module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native‑image awareness.

**Spring Ecosystem**

1. **Spring Boot 3.x** – create micro‑service skeletons, auto‑configuration, actuator health‑checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2).,
  
2. **Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC)** – entity mapping, query‑hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation.
  
3. **Spring Cloud basics** – service discovery (Eureka), API‑gateway pattern, externalized config (Config Server), and circuit‑breaker (Resilience4j).

4. Either Spring Batch **OR** Spring MVC **OR** Spring Integration

5. **Spring Security**– CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource‑server setup, basic role‑based access control, and token validation, zero trust, MTLS.

**Database & Data Access Engineering**

1. **SQL & query optimisation** – complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution‑plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL).

2. **Database optimisation -** (indexing, query plans). Understanding of partitioning
  
3. **ORM performance** – JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second‑level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints.
  
4. **NoSQL & caching** – when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache‑aside), basic data‑modeling, and TTL/eviction policies.
  
5. **Migrations & transactions** – Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi‑DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation‑level choices.

**Design & Architecture**

1. **Clean / Hexagonal architecture** – ports‑and‑adapters, dependency‑inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring.
  
2. **Domain‑Driven Design basics** – bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing.
  
3. **API‑first & contract** – OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer‑driven contract testing (Pact).
  
4. **Event‑driven patterns** – Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out‑box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation.

5. **Security**: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security.

6. Microservices **design Pattern** ex: SAGA Design pattern

Concepts like -Circuit breaker, load balancer, Reverse Proxy

7. Integration Patterns, Enterprise Patterns, Application scalability (stateful & stateless), Microservices Patterns, Distributed Transactions

8. **Caching Strategies** (Redis, CDN)

**DevOps**

1. **Containerisation & K8s** – Docker multi‑stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes.
  
2. **CI/CD pipeline** – Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static‑analysis steps; artefact publishing. Pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile/YAML)
  
3. **Observability starter** – expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK.

4. Runtime security, secret‑management (CyberArk / Hashicorp / equivalent)

5. Canary/blue‑green release patterns

**Testing & Quality Engineering**

1. **Test‑pyramid implementation** – unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact).
  
2. **Performance & load testing** – JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results.
  
3. **Static analysis & coverage** – SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set.

**Frontend**

Proficient working within existing Angular/TypeScript/NodeJS/NPM frameworks.

**AI Tools**

Daily use of AI DevAssistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate implementation across all skill areas

Understanding of MCP and Agentic concepts and able to develop and design.

Experience with Prompt Engineering, codebase context and constraints of AI assistants

**Behavioral Skills**

* Sets technical direction for multiple squads and aligns it with business objectives

* Cross-functional collaboration across frontend, QA, DecvSecOps and infrastructure teams

* Balances speed, quality, and regulatory constraints in a fast-moving environment and is results oriented

* Ensures that security, data‑privacy, and regulatory requirements are baked in.

* Structured communication of technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders

* Adaptability to legacy and greenfield environments delivering modern, cloud‑native solutions.

* Leverages generative AI to boost productivity and foster a culture of experimentation

**Education Level:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Location: Chennai | Type: Fulltime**

**About Newpage Solutions**

  

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.

We are proud to be a ‘Great Place to Work®’ certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives.

**Your Mission**

We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built—not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.

You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.

This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.

**What You’ll Do**

**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

**Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents—with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.

**Test, Deploy, Productionize**

* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless—chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline: hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

  

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches—fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel—with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave—and where they break—and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

  

**What We Offer**

  

At Newpage, we’re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

  

**Ready to Apply?**

  

Let’s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to:
  
*shubhi.tiwari@newpage.io*

  

#### **More about Newpage**

Newpage is a digital health solutions company. We devote ourselves to advancing the quality of life by enhancing health and optimizing the longevity of people. We do this by, passionately building futuristic technologies for global organizations across the healthcare ecosystem. We partake at every stage from problem definition, strategy & service design, user research, UX design, and agile software development – utilizing lean practices to deliver and validate highly innovative digital health solutions that drive user value and business transformation.

Newpage is recognized by ‘CIO’s Review’ as “Top 50 Promising Healthcare Solution Providers” and Great Place to Work Certified (GPTW) 2023 & 2024.

title: Software Technical Lead
description:
**Software Technical Lead**

**Job title:** Software Technical Lead  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Work model:** Primarily Office Based  
**Reporting to:** Engineering Manager  
**Team size:** Initially 4–7 software engineers, with close collaboration across QA, DevOps/platform engineering, and firmware/hardware-adjacent teams

**About the role**

ePropelled develops intelligent propulsion and power management systems for uncrewed vehicles. We are looking for a hands-on Software Technical Lead to develop cloud-based software that connects our hardware products with user applications.

Your strongest experience will be in software development, backend services and full-stack delivery. You will bring strong production development skills in Python or Java, experience delivering containerised services, and practical exposure to IoT, telemetry or other connected-device systems.

You will lead technical decisions, contribute code and help other engineers deliver reliable software. Working with firmware and hardware colleagues, you will develop a deeper understanding of our devices, their interfaces and the environments in which they operate.

Prior experience developing embedded firmware, motor-control software or autonomous-vehicle software is not required.

**What you will do**

* Lead the design and delivery of backend services, APIs, telemetry processing and supporting web applications.
* Remain directly involved in implementation, code review, troubleshooting and technical problem-solving for approximately 70–80% of your time.
* Design service boundaries, data models and interfaces, choosing an appropriate architecture for the product’s scale and complexity.
* Develop and deploy containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes, working with colleagues responsible for infrastructure and operations.
* Build and improve automated tests, CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
* Use logs, metrics and traces to diagnose problems and improve service reliability.
* Work with firmware and hardware engineers to define device-to-platform interfaces, data formats, version compatibility and failure behaviour.
* Address connected-system concerns such as intermittent connectivity, retries, duplicate messages, device identity and access control.
* Contribute to web dashboards and operational interfaces, and guide integration between frontend and backend components.
* Mentor engineers, explain technical trade-offs and help translate product requirements into achievable development work.
* You will work with an experienced Software Engineering Manager who will handle day-to-day line management and scheduling. This is a technical leadership role, not a line-management role.

**Essential experience**

* We are looking for evidence of the following capabilities:

**Hands-on technical leadership.** You have taken responsibility for substantial software delivery, made and explained architectural decisions, reviewed code and supported other engineers. You continue to write and debug production code.

**Strong Python or Java development.** You have built and maintained production backend services in at least one of these languages and can explain your approach to testing, performance, concurrency and maintainability. You are willing to learn other languages where the work requires them.

**Cloud and distributed systems.** You have delivered services on a cloud platform and have practical experience with microservices, APIs and asynchronous messaging. You understand trade-offs involving consistency, failure handling, scalability and operational complexity.

**Containers and Kubernetes.** You have practical experience packaging, deploying and troubleshooting applications using Docker and Kubernetes.

**CI/CD and production quality.** You have worked with version control, automated builds, tests and controlled releases, and have contributed to improving these practices.

**Observability.** You have used logs, metrics and tracing to investigate production behaviour. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry is relevant; familiarity with every named tool is not required.

**Genuine connected-system exposure.** You have contributed to a deployed IoT, telemetry, device-management, industrial monitoring, telematics or comparable hardware-connected system. You can explain your own contribution, how device data reached the application, and how you investigated integration or reliability problems.

Full-stack delivery. You understand how modern web applications interact with backend services and have contributed to delivering user-facing functionality. Your deepest expertise may be in backend development; direct ownership of cloud infrastructure is not the primary focus of this role.

**Data and security fundamentals.** You have practical SQL and relational database experience, together with an understanding of authentication, authorisation, secrets handling and secure service communication.

**Collaboration and learning.** You communicate clearly, investigate unfamiliar problems systematically and work effectively with colleagues from other engineering disciplines.

At least seven years of relevant software engineering experience, including technical leadership responsibilities, is required.

**Useful additional experience**

Any of the following would be valuable. You do not need experience in all of them:

* MQTT, device provisioning, device identity or remote software updates.
* Edge gateways, Linux-based devices or systems that operate with unreliable connectivity.
* PostgreSQL, time-series data or telemetry storage and processing.
* Practical development experience in both Python and Java. Proficiency in at least one is essential; experience with both is an advantage.
* Frontend frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue.
* Robotics, manufacturing, industrial automation or uncrewed vehicles.
* Integrating AI or machine-learning services into a production application.

**Technical ownership and development**

Your initial technical ownership will focus on software development. You will lead the development of software deployed on cloud platforms and integrated with connected devices and user applications. Firmware and hardware colleagues will contribute their specialist knowledge and collaborate on interfaces, diagnostics and system behaviour. Platform Engineering colleagues will provide infrastructure and specialist expertise in CI/CD, deployment and platform operations.

You will be expected to develop a broader understanding over time, ask informed questions and recognise when specialist input is needed.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. It involves guiding software engineers in their approach to software development and taking responsibility for technical delivery.

Background and qualifications

A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience is welcome.

We consider candidates from different industries. What matters is evidence of production software development and delivery, technical leadership and relevant connected-system experience.

If you meet the essential capabilities but have not used every technology mentioned, we encourage you to apply. Please describe a system you helped deliver, your personal contribution and a difficult technical problem you resolved.

If you are interested, kindly share your updated resume to hr-india@epropelled.com or anithak@epropelled.com

**About Us**
------------

MulticoreWare is a global software solutions & products company with its HQ in San Jose, CA, USA. With worldwide offices, it serves its clients and partners in North America, EMEA and APAC regions. Started by a group of researchers, MulticoreWare has grown to serve its clients and partners on HPC & Cloud computing, GPUs, Multicore & Multithread CPUS, DSPs, FPGAs and a variety of AI hardware accelerators.

MulticoreWare was founded by a team of researchers that wanted a better way to program for heterogeneous architectures. With the advent of GPUs and the increasing prevalence of multi-core, multi-architecture platforms, our clients were struggling with the difficulties of using these platforms efficiently.

We started as a boot-strapped services company and have since expanded our portfolio to span products and services related to compilers, machine learning, video codecs, image processing and augmented/virtual reality. Our hardware expertise has also expanded with our team; we now employ experts on HPC and Cloud Computing, GPUs, DSPs, FPGAs, and mobile and embedded platforms. We specialize in accelerating software and algorithms, so if your code targets a multi-core, heterogeneous platform, we can help.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are looking for a Junior LLVM Backend Engineer to join our compiler engineering team. In this role, you will work on backend components of the compiler toolchain targeting custom hardware architectures. You will have the opportunity to work closely with experienced compiler engineers on LLVM IR transformations, instruction selection, and backend optimizations to improve generated code quality and performance.

This role is ideal for candidates with a strong foundation in compiler design, C/C++, and systems programming who are looking to build expertise in LLVM and compiler backend development.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist in developing and maintaining LLVM backend components for custom or existing target architectures.
* Support implementation and enhancement of instruction selection, code generation, and target-specific optimizations.
* Work on LLVM IR-level transformations and optimization passes under guidance from senior engineers.
* Analyze generated assembly/code to identify performance improvements and optimization opportunities.
* Debug compiler-related issues across different stages of the compilation flow.
* Collaborate with hardware and software teams to understand architecture-specific requirements.
* Contribute to testing, validation, and benchmarking of compiler features and optimizations.
* Learn and contribute to LLVM-based development workflows and internal compiler infrastructure.

### **Requirements**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.

**Technical Skills (Must haves):**

* Good understanding of compiler design fundamentals.
* Strong programming skills in C/C++.
* Basic understanding of LLVM architecture and compiler pipelines.
* Familiarity with data structures, algorithms, and operating system concepts.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Willingness to learn and work on low-level systems and compiler technologies.

**Need to have (Can be bridged):**

* No additional bridged skills were specifically identified.

**Good to have (Not essential):**

* Exposure to assembly language or computer architecture concepts.
* Familiarity with Linux development environments and build systems.

**Preferred Qualifications (Optional):**

* Academic/project experience in compilers, LLVM, operating systems, or systems programming.

* Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience with Hexagon SmartPlant Instrumentation (SPI), including at least 3 years in SPI Administration, with strong expertise in managing SPI databases, configurations, and administrative functions.

* Familiarity with GSAP, SQL, Power BI, AIM‑A, Digital Twin, and other integrated engineering tools is preferred.
* Strong understanding of instrumentation used in oil & gas, petrochemical, or related process industries.
* Knowledge of Shell‑specific specifications, data standards, and document management systems is an advantage.
* Experience collaborating with EPCs, engineering teams, and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and troubleshooting capability for instrumentation and data issues.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and locations.

* Quality-driven and detail-oriented, with the ability to ensure consistency and completeness across deliverables.

* Analytical mindset with problem-solving capability, applying engineering best practices and standards to improve outcomes.

* Ability to prioritize effectively and deliver against commitments in a dynamic project environment.

* Demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Strong team collaboration and mentoring approach, with the ability to guide junior designers and drive best practices.

* Shift work following operating hours of the operation units across the globe.
* Virtual working with key stakeholders for day-to-day operations
* Effective initiative to identify and help resolve business and technical issues within areas of responsibility.
* A self-starter and reliable deliverer, with good verbal and written skills in English.
Exposes the individual to all cultural backgrounds and organizational levels across the globe, across diverse time zones.  

**What we offer**

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.



**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.  

**Shell in India**

Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.

Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.

Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.

Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.

Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.

We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

**DISCLAIMER:**

Please note: We occasionally amend or withdraw Shell jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Before applying, you are advised to read our data protection policy. This policy describes the processing that may be associated with your personal data and informs you that your personal data may be transferred to Shell/Shell Group companies around the world. The Shell Group and its approved recruitment consultants will never ask you for a fee to process or consider your application for a career with Shell. Anyone who demands such a fee is not an authorised Shell representative and you are strongly advised to refuse any such demand. Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Site Reliablity Engineer II
description:
**Launch Your AI/ML Career as an Machine Learning Engineer**
============================================================

Are you passionate about the foundational elements of machine learning and eager to contribute to innovative AI solutions within a collaborative, supportive team environment? Trimble is seeking an enthusiastic early-career professional to join our Construction Management Solutions (CMS) group within the AECO sector in Chennai. This role offers an exceptional entry point to build a career in AI/ML engineering, working directly alongside seasoned data scientists and engineers to solve real-world industry challenges using cutting-edge technologies.

**About Us:**
-------------

Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com

**About Our Division: Construction Management Solutions (CMS)**

As an industry leader in construction software and ERP solutions, Trimble CMS empowers contractors worldwide. Our solutions connect essential business functions like accounting, project management, and field operations within a unified digital environment. Operating on Trimble Construction One (TC1), our collaborative cloud solutions enhance accountability, efficiency, and profitability for organizations across the globe.

**What Makes This Role Great:**
-------------------------------

This role provides a structured environment for developing core competencies in machine learning, data engineering, and data science under the direct mentorship of senior practitioners. Based in our Chennai office, you will gain hands-on exposure to real-world industrial data, contribute to the foundational stages of the ML project lifecycle, and learn modern MLOps practices like containerization and automated monitoring. It is a premier platform for an ambitious technologist to translate academic theory into scalable, enterprise-grade AI products.

**Key Exciting Responsibilities**
---------------------------------

* **Model Implementation & Experimentation:** Assist in the development, testing, and deployment of foundational machine learning algorithms and models under direct supervision, with opportunities to explore advanced deep learning architectures.
* **Data Engineering & Preprocessing:** Contribute to data collection pipelines, feature engineering, and data cleaning tasks to ensure high-quality training sets tailored to industry use cases.
* **Code Quality & System Testing:** Perform routine debugging, unit testing, and comprehensive code documentation to ensure reliability, reproducibility, and high software standards.
* **Model Integration & MLOps:** Support the integration of trained ML models into existing enterprise applications, learning foundational MLOps workflows including containerization, deployment pipelines, and post-deployment performance monitoring.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with senior engineers and data scientists to translate business requirements into clear, manageable ML tasks while adopting industry best practices.

**Essential Skills & Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field (Trimble's Professional ladder typically requires four or more years of formal education).
* **Foundational ML Literacy:** Solid conceptual understanding of machine learning principles, evaluation metrics, statistical methods, and foundational deep learning concepts.
* **Programming Proficiency:** Strong coding skills in Python with practical experience in data manipulation and algorithm design using standard libraries such as NumPy, pandas, and scikit-learn.
* **Data Structures & Problem Solving:** Solid understanding of fundamental data structures and basic data modeling concepts, with the ability to follow structured engineering methodologies to solve well-defined problems.

### **Bonus Points For:**

* Practical familiarity with standard deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Baseline understanding of cloud environments (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP).
* Hands-on experience with version control systems (Git/GitHub) and basic Linux/Bash scripting.
* A strong academic portfolio or GitHub profile showcasing practical ML/data science projects.
* Academic exposure to generative AI concepts, transformer architectures, or Large Language Models (LLMs).

**Logistics:**
--------------

* **Location:** Chennai, India
* **Department:** Construction Management Solutions (CMS)
* **Role Level:** P2
* **Job Type:** Full-Time

**Why You'll Love Working With Us**
-----------------------------------

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

* **You'll work on projects that truly matter:** Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* **Collaborate with like-minded people:** Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* **Be an owner:** Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* **Enjoy true flexibility:** We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

**How to Apply:** Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.

**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.
