**Job Description:**

**Job Title: CPQ Customer Portal Specialist**
=============================================

**Role Summary**
----------------

The **CPQ Customer Portal Specialist** is responsible for the **configuration, maintenance, and operational support of CPQ customer‑facing portals** that enable customers and sales teams to configure products, view quotations, and submit requests digitally.

The role ensures that the **customer portal experience is stable, user‑friendly, and aligned with CPQ backend logic** , pricing rules, and order processes. Working closely with sales, CPQ teams, IT, and stakeholders, this role focuses on **portal setup, issue resolution, enhancements, and continuous improvement** to support seamless customer interaction with CPQ solutions.

  

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Customer Portal Configuration & Maintenance**

* Configure and maintain **CPQ customer portals** , including product views, configuration flows, and user access.
* Ensure portal configurations accurately reflect **CPQ products, rules, pricing logic, and availability** .
* Maintain content, layouts, forms, and guided selling flows within the customer portal.
Implement approved changes and enhancements in line with CPQ governance.  

  

### **User Experience & Functional Support**

* Ensure an intuitive and consistent **customer and sales user experience** across portal journeys.
* Troubleshoot portal‑related issues impacting configuration, pricing display, or submission flows.
* Act as a subject‑matter expert for **customer portal behavior and dependencies** .

  

### **Integration & Data Alignment**

* Ensure seamless interaction between **customer portals and CPQ backend systems** .
* Validate correct data handover between portal, CPQ, and downstream systems where applicable.
Support alignment of portal logic with Sales BOM (SBOM) and quotation outputs.  

  

### **Testing, Validation & Quality Assurance**

* Perform **functional testing and regression testing** for portal changes and releases.
* Support **System Integration Testing (SIT)** and **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** for portal enhancements.
Ensure portal updates do not negatively impact existing CPQ configurations or order flows.  

  

### **Issue Resolution & Operational Support**

* Analyze and resolve portal‑related issues raised by customers, sales, or internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate with CPQ, IT, and platform teams to ensure timely resolution.
Perform root‑cause analysis and support permanent fixes.  

  

### **Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Maintain **portal configuration documentation, user guidance, and support notes** .
* Create and update **how‑to guides, FAQs, and release notes** related to portal functionality.
Support knowledge transfer to internal teams and stakeholders.  

  

### **Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve **portal usability, performance, and adoption** .
* Proactively highlight gaps, risks, or enhancement opportunities in portal design or flow.
Contribute to standardization and best practices for CPQ customer portals.  

  

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in **Information Technology, Engineering, Digital Systems, or a related discipline** .
* **5–8 years of experience** in customer portal management, CPQ support, or digital sales platforms.
* Experience working with **CPQ tools, customer portals, or sales configurators** .
* Strong understanding of **configuration flows, pricing visibility, and customer journey design** .
* Experience supporting **Configure‑to‑Order (CTO)** and/or **Engineer‑to‑Order (ETO)** environments is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of **CPQ integrations and data handover concepts** .
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cross‑functional and global teams.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English.

title: Senior Data Engineer – Azure Databricks | AI & Agentic Lakehouse
description:
**Company:** Efforts Solutions IT  
**Job Location:** Remote Initially from Chennai | Abu Dhabi, UAE (Potential Onsite Relocation after 2 months if required)  
**Experience:** 7+ Years  
**Reporting To:** AI & Data Manager

About the Opportunity

Efforts Solutions IT is looking for a highly skilled **Senior Data Engineer (Azure Databricks)** to lead the architecture, development, and implementation of an enterprise-grade **AI-powered Agentic Lakehouse** for a major enterprise initiative.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on building a modern data platform using **Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, PySpark, and Azure Data Factory**, integrating enterprise data with intelligent AI-driven automation.

The successful candidate will work closely with the AI & Data Manager, internal engineering teams, and external delivery partners to transform complex enterprise data into secure, governed, and reusable data products.

Work Arrangement & Relocation

* **Initial Engagement:** Remote for the first 2 months.
* **Performance Evaluation:** Technical capabilities and delivery performance will be assessed during the initial engagement.
* **Potential Relocation:** Following successful evaluation, the role may require relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE, for an onsite or hybrid engagement.
* **Contract Extension:** Subject to project requirements, performance, and mutual agreement.

**Important:** Candidates must be willing and able to relocate to Abu Dhabi after the initial remote engagement if required. Please apply only if you are comfortable with this arrangement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Lakehouse Architecture & Engineering**

* Lead the design and implementation of an enterprise-scale Azure Databricks Lakehouse.
* Establish Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) using Delta Lake.
* Define data modelling standards, data contracts, and reusable engineering frameworks.
* Design scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines.

**2. Data Integration & Pipeline Development**

* Develop ingestion pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, PySpark, and SQL.
* Integrate data from ERP databases, legacy systems, SharePoint, business applications, and REST APIs.
* Implement automated data cleansing, validation, transformation, and migration.
* Optimise pipelines for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost.

**3. Data Governance & Security**

* Implement Unity Catalog for data governance, access controls, lineage, and classification.
* Configure governed data access across enterprise data domains.
* Apply data-quality controls, exception handling, quarantine processes, and auditability.
* Support secure integration with Azure services and enterprise environments.

**4. AI & Agentic Data Automation**

* Design and prototype AI agents for automated data discovery, profiling, and onboarding.
* Implement AI-assisted schema inference, data-quality rule generation, and anomaly detection.
* Support entity resolution, metadata enrichment, and intelligent data cleansing.
* Enable governed data access for AI agents using SQL endpoints, vector indexes, and MCP-style services.
* Integrate LLM capabilities using Azure OpenAI and related Azure AI services.

**5. Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead technical design decisions and establish data engineering best practices.
* Review code and guide internal engineers and external delivery partners.
* Implement Git-based version control and CI/CD for data pipelines.
* Apply Databricks cost optimisation practices, including cluster policies and compute selection.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver project milestones.

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Assess existing enterprise data sources, pipelines, and data-quality challenges.
* Define the target Lakehouse architecture and implementation blueprint.
* Establish Databricks Medallion layers, Unity Catalog, and ingestion foundations.
* Build initial ingestion and transformation pipelines for priority business domains.
* Implement data-quality validation and governance controls.
* Prototype AI-assisted data profiling, quality-rule generation, and onboarding workflows.
* Demonstrate working deliverables and document the technical implementation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **7+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering**, including senior-level technical ownership.
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise Lakehouse or modern data platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise in **Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Medallion Architecture**.
* Advanced proficiency in **Python, PySpark, and SQL**.
* Experience with Databricks Workflows, Delta Live Tables / Lakeflow, and production data pipelines.
* Strong knowledge of Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Azure Key Vault, and Azure networking.
* Experience with data governance, access controls, lineage, and data-quality frameworks.
* Hands-on experience integrating and cleansing ERP or legacy enterprise data.
* Practical exposure to LLM-powered data workflows, Azure OpenAI, or AI-driven automation.
* Experience implementing CI/CD using Azure DevOps or Git-based pipelines.
* Strong problem-solving, architecture design, communication, and technical leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.
* Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or enterprise metadata management.
* Exposure to Azure AI Search, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI agents, MCP integrations, or intelligent data services.
* Previous experience in enterprise digital transformation or complex data migration projects.

**Technology Stack**

Azure Databricks | Delta Lake | Unity Catalog | PySpark | Python | SQL | Azure Data Factory | ADLS Gen2 | Azure OpenAI | Azure AI Search | Azure DevOps | Git | CI/CD | Lakeflow | Databricks Workflows

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are requested to submit their updated CV along with the following information:

* Total years of Data Engineering experience.
* Years of hands-on Azure Databricks experience.
* Experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and PySpark.
* Experience in Lakehouse architecture and AI/LLM-based data workflows.
* Current location and availability to join.
* Expected monthly remuneration for the initial remote engagement and for onsite role.
* Confirmation of willingness to relocate to Abu Dhabi after 2 months, if required.

**Please apply only if you have strong hands-on Azure Databricks experience and are open to potential relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE.**

**About Efforts Solutions IT**

Efforts Solutions IT is an Abu Dhabi-based technology company established in 2009, delivering Enterprise AI, Intelligent Automation, Data Engineering, Digital Transformation, and IT Outsourcing services to enterprise and government organisations across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and international markets.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:

We are looking for a skilled Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to support server migration, infrastructure modernisation and cloud operations. The ideal candidate should have strong Windows Server administration skills, working knowledge of Linux and networking, and experience supporting infrastructure migration projects.

The role involves migration planning, readiness assessments, execution support, troubleshooting, quality validation and coordination with technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Execute server migration activities, including rehosting and replatforming.
* Perform infrastructure readiness checks before scheduled migration activities.
* Validate network connectivity, bandwidth and replication requirements.
* Support migration planning, production cutovers and rollback activities.
* Troubleshoot Windows, Linux, networking and server replication issues.
* Work with cloud migration tools and block-level replication technologies.
* Support server workloads involving database environments.
* Review technical documentation, migration plans and implementation procedures.
* Validate technical deliverables for accuracy and completeness.
* Coordinate with architects, technical leads, application teams and clients.
* Support junior engineers through technical guidance and deliverable reviews.
* Follow approved migration procedures, operational controls and security requirements.
* Manage multiple infrastructure workloads while maintaining quality and timelines.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5–8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, server administration or migration projects.
* Experience participating in at least one complete infrastructure migration project.
* Hands-on knowledge of Windows Server administration.
* Working knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting.
* Experience with AWS cloud services and server migration tools, preferably AWS Application Migration Service (AWS MGN), or equivalent technologies.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, DNS, routing, firewalls and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Ability to independently manage assigned workloads throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with technical teams and learn new technologies quickly.

Good to Have

* Experience with cloud migration frameworks and automation tools.
* Exposure to Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code technologies.
* Familiarity with database migration tools.
* Experience with large-scale data centre migration projects.
* Exposure to regulated or security-sensitive environments.
* Understanding of data privacy and infrastructure security practices.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will have strong infrastructure fundamentals, hands-on server administration experience and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. Candidates with strong Windows Server expertise and partial cloud migration exposure may also be considered if they demonstrate good learning ability and adaptability.

Work Arrangement

* Remote working opportunity.

* Preferred candidate locations include Noida, Pune, Mangalore and Chennai.

**Note:** Practical experience in infrastructure migration and strong technical troubleshooting skills are important for this role.

title: Systems Engineering Advisor - Endpoint Management
description:
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer – Enterprise Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 9–12 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with proven technical leadership in large-scale ManageEngine and Microsoft Intune environments, ideally within an India-based global delivery model.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with seniority. Comprehensive benefits including health insurance (self, spouse, children, and parents), PF, gratuity, performance bonus, LTA, NPS, and professional certification reimbursement.
  
**Work Hours:** IST-aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking an experienced ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex ManageEngine/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Technical Leadership Architecture
  

* Lead end-to-end design and implementation of enterprise ManageEngine/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
* Own the technical direction for SCCM-to-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
* Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.

Enterprise Patch Management
  

* Own enterprise-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000+ endpoint fleets.
* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR-based patching for complex multi-site global environments.
* Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with ManageEngine/Intune patch deployment cycles.
* Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead emergency and zero-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post-incident review from India delivery centre.

Advanced OS Deployment Provisioning
  

* Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.
* Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.
* Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.

Automation Integration
  

* Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy SCCM enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.

Client Engagement Delivery Governance
  

* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* ManageEngine Endpoint Management Tool (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) — required
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect or Security Engineer certifications
* Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Intune Advanced Analytics
* Prior India-based delivery leadership for Fortune 500 global accounts (10,000+ endpoints)
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, India IT Act compliance, and global data residency considerations in EPM

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc. CS or IT) from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent enterprise experience and advanced Microsoft certifications will be considered.
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

title: Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune
description:
**Req ID:** 392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
**Work Hours:** IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

* 12+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering leadership — managing managers and leading teams of 15+ engineers.

* Demonstrated experience with hexagonal architecture at scale — enforcing domain isolation as teams and services grow.

* Strong cross-functional leadership: experience working closely with Product Management, Design, and executive stakeholders across geographies (US-India distributed teams).

* Track record of recruiting and developing senior engineering talent — building teams from the ground up in competitive markets.

* Experience delivering in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments with evolving platform dependencies and shifting priorities.

Good to Have

* Experience leading engineering teams building AI-native products (LLM integration, agentic systems, scoring pipelines, MCP tool design).

* Background in martech, customer data platforms, or dealer/automotive technology.

* Prior experience managing both backend and frontend engineering disciplines within the same org.

* Medical insurance coverage.

* Work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley's most dominant and successful companies.

title: Customer Support Agent (Trading Platform)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is one of the most advanced platforms for seeing and trading the markets. Traders use it to read price and volume through professional orderflow tools - footprint charts, volume profile, cumulative delta, DOM - to analyse the market and to place orders through their broker, all in the browser.

Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world: from people learning to read orderflow to professionals who trade every session. 3M+ registered traders, PE-backed since 2025, profitable, with a mandate to scale 10x over four years.

**The role**

You'll be the person traders talk to when they need help with GoCharting - and the person who actually solves it.

The questions are rarely simple. A footprint chart looks different from what a trader expects. Data for a symbol is delayed. A broker connection drops just before the market opens. An order didn't go through. A subscription didn't renew. Behind each message is a trader who is in the middle of a session and is losing time or money while they wait.

Your job is to understand the product deeply enough to find the real cause, give a complete answer, and - when it's a bug - give our engineers everything they need to fix it. Over time, you become one of the people in the company who knows the product best and knows what traders struggle with.

**What you'll do**

* Solve product questions end to end. Charts and indicators, orderflow tools, market data, broker connections and order execution, account and billing. Reproduce the problem in the platform yourself, check the obvious causes, and come back with an answer that closes the question.
* Write answers that close the question. One complete, professional reply instead of several chat bubbles. You'll work to our Communication Standards - a short guide on tone, structure and what a complete answer looks like.
* Explain the product to traders. Help people set up and read footprint charts, volume profile, DOM and other tools - clearly, in their terms, without a script.
* Troubleshoot technical issues. Check what the trader sees, look at the browser console, compare accounts and settings, narrow it down before escalating.
* Escalate bugs with evidence. Write bug reports an engineer can act on without asking a follow-up question: what the trader did, what happened, what was expected, environment, screenshots, whether it reproduces.
* React fast during incidents. When data or the platform has a problem during market hours, flag it immediately and keep traders informed.
* Turn repeated questions into knowledge. Write and improve help articles and saved replies, so the next trader with the same question gets the answer faster.
* Be the trader's voice inside the company. Tag conversations properly and bring patterns to the team: what confuses traders, what breaks, what they keep asking for.

  

**How we think about the work**

Every action in the inbox has consequences down the line. A wrong tag hides a problem from the people who could fix it. A premature close brings the trader back angrier. A vague escalation costs an engineer an hour. We look for people who think about what happens next - to the trader, to the colleague who picks up after them, and to the team that receives the escalation.

**You're probably a fit if**

* You write excellent English - clear, calm and complete. This is the core of the job.
* You have 2+ years of customer-facing support for a technical product, ideally B2C SaaS or fintech, working a real inbox (chat, email, messaging).
* You like figuring out how things work. You can follow a UI, read an error, reproduce a problem and use browser DevTools at a basic level.
* You take ownership of a conversation until it's solved, not until it's handed off.
* Strong plus: you trade, or you've supported a trading, brokerage or market-data product. You know what a chart, an order book, a session and a broker connection are - and ideally you've used orderflow tools yourself.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with a modern helpdesk (Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk or similar); writing help articles; Hindi and / or Tamil.

  

**Probably not a fit if**

* You prefer ready-made scripts to understanding the product and the actual question.
* You see escalation as "passing the ticket on".

  

**Working hours**

We support traders across Indian and US market hours, so the team works in shifts, including evening and night shifts (remote), with weekend and public holiday shifts on a rotation. Shift, weekend and holiday work come with allowances.

**Logistics**  
Location: Chennai, India.

Employment type: Full-time, Onsite/Hybrid.

Reports to: Customer Support lead.

*If you've read this far, please start your answer to the first question with the word "Orderflow" - so we know you've read the whole description.*

description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As **Senior Security Architect**, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**

* Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high-level and low-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.
* Carry out architecture and risk reviews of proposed high-risk changes (firewall, intrusion prevention, gateway, privileged access and application control) before they are presented to the client's Change Advisory Board.
* Define logging and audit requirements for in-scope security tools, including log sources, feed requirements for the client's retained SIEM, and a retention architecture aligned with client policy and regulatory obligations.
* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.
* Produce NIS Regulations and NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) alignment assessments and contribute evidence to the client's regulatory reporting.
* Prepare inputs for the client's governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) reporting on the enterprise's security status.
* Develop risk treatment plans in line with client policy and industry best practice and maintain inputs to the security risk register.
* Prepare technical content and risk papers for the client's cyber security governance board, in support of the UK Head of Service and the Lead Information Risk Manager.
* Maintain the master set of security architecture diagrams and ensure that diagrams produced by the engineering team are consistent and up to date.
* Identify and assess continual improvement opportunities, including benefit-cost appraisal and sequencing into quick wins, foundational change and strategic uplift.
* Apply appropriate consideration of operational technology (OT) and IT/OT boundary risk in all architecture and design work.
* Provide technical leadership, peer review and mentoring to the Lead Security Engineer, Security Engineers and Vulnerability and Patch Manager.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client-facing delivery excellence.

Qualifications:

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP or SABSA Chartered Foundation (at least one required).
* TOGAF, a cloud security certification (e.g. CCSP, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty) or GICSP/ISA/IEC 62443 certification would be advantageous.

Essential skills:

* Enterprise security architecture across network, identity, endpoint, cloud and data security domains.
* Designing logging and SIEM integration architectures, including log source definition and retention requirements.
* Applying risk assessment methods such as ISO/IEC 27005 and NIST SP 800-30.
* Working knowledge of the NIS Regulations, NCSC CAF, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls.
* Reviewing proposed changes for architectural and security risk, and producing clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* Excellent written communication for executive, governance and regulator-facing documentation.

Ability to lead and quality-assure the work of other engineers

Desired skills:

* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Knowledge of OT/ICS security concepts, the Purdue model and IEC 62443.
* Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. ServiceNow IRM, Archer).
* Experience with Ofgem or NIS-regulated cyber assurance activity.

Experience:

* 12+ years in IT and cybersecurity, including 6+ years in security architecture for enterprise or CNI environments.
* Experience producing architecture, design and risk artefacts for regulated organisations.
* Experience supporting governance boards, risk registers and GRC reporting.
* Experience working with multi-supplier environments and managed security service providers.

What do I need before I apply:

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening *(equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard)* and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

Benefits:

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits *[India HR to confirm the benefits package].*
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”

If you are an experienced Security Architect with a strong background in enterprise and CNI security architecture, and you enjoy shaping how critical services are secured, we encourage you to apply today.

Job Summary  
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.  
  
  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)  
  
. Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.  
. Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.  
. Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.  
. Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.  
. Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.  
  
2. Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering  
  
. Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.  
. Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.  
. Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.  
. Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.  
  
3. Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering  
  
. Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).  
. Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.  
. Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.  
. Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.  
  
4. Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration  
  
. Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.  
. Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.  
. Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).  
. Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.  
  
5. Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture  
  
. Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).  
. Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.  
. Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.  
. Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).  
  
6. Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning  
  
. Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.  
. Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.  
. Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.  
. Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.  
  
7. Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture  
  
. Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.  
. Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.  
. Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.  
. Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.  
  
8. Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship  
  
. Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).  
. Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.  
. Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.  
. Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.

System Upgrades

As a Technical Anchor, you will oversee the technical design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications and high-throughput data platforms. You will establish engineering excellence across full-stack systems, architect resilient Java-based microservices, deliver responsive front-end data exploration interfaces using React or Angular, and design enterprise-grade cloud data streaming and analytical pipelines on GCP. You will lead distributed engineering squads across local and global locations, driving cloud modernization, data governance, and operational reliability to fuel Ford’s digital transformation.

### **1. Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization**

* **Anchor Technical Delivery:** Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.
* **Architecture Standards:** Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* **Legacy System Modernization:** Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* **Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence:** Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.

### **2. Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering**

* **Backend Services:** Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* **Frontend & Data Visualization:** Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* **API Gateway & Service Mesh:** Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* **Performance Engineering & Optimization:** Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.

### **3. Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics**

* **Scalable Data Pipelines:** Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* **Modern Data Warehousing:** Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.

### **4. Security, Governance & Compliance**

* **Zero Trust Security:** Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* **Cloud & Data Governance:** Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.

### **5. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability**

* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* **CI/CD Automation:** Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* **Operational Reliability & Telemetry:** Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* **AI/ML Innovation:** Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Professional Experience:** 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across full-stack development, distributed computing, and data platforms.
    
  **Core Technical Competencies:**
* **Backend Engineering:** Deep expertise in **Java (Java 17+)**, **Spring Ecosystem** (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* **Frontend Engineering:** Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using **React**, **Angular**, or **Node.js**.
* **GCP Cloud Platforms:** Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, specifically **BigQuery**, **Cloud Run**, **GKE** and **Cloud Pub/Sub**.
* **Database Systems:** Strong practical expertise with relational databases (**PostgreSQL**, **MySQL**), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* **DevOps & IaC:** Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform**, containerization (**Docker**, **Kubernetes**), and automated CI/CD tools (**GitHub Actions**, **Tekton**, **Maven/Gradle**).
* **API & Testing Standards:** Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (**OpenAPI/Swagger**) paired with a test-driven mindset using **JUnit** and **Mockito**

Own data reconciliation between the SAS output and the Snowflake output build rowcount controltotal and recordlevel comparison scripts investigate breaks and sign off each migrated object against agreed tolerance

Reengineer SAS data access layers that read from files RDBMS sources and SAS datasets so they land in Snowflake through the programmes chosen ingestion pattern

Work with the architecture team on target data models translating SASera structures into curated Snowflake schemas that suit setbased processing

Tune migrated workloads for cost and performance warehouse sizing clustering pruning and query rewrites so that converted jobs meet or beat their existing batch windows

Engage report owners and business analysts to confirm interpretation of legacy logic retire redundant code instead of migrating it and support user acceptance testing through to cutover

Maintain migration artefacts mapping documents conversion standards test evidence and runbooks and mentor junior engineers on reading SAS code safely

MustHave Skills

Strong handson Base SAS SAS Macro PROC SQL and DATA step development including formats informats arrays hash objects and bygroup processing

Proven ability to read and reverseengineer undocumented longlived SAS programs and explain what they do in business terms

Advanced SQL with practical exposure to Snowflake virtual warehouses stages streams tasks time travel cloning and micropartition behaviour

Experience on at least one completed legacytocloud data migration with responsibility for validation and reconciliation not only code conversion

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262362 **Date posted** 10/21/2026

**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**

**GCL: D3**

**Introduction to role:**
-------------------------

Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

* *Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions:* Design, build, and version enterprise-grade **shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows)** and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* **GitHub Actions Platform Development:** Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable **GitHub Actions** (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* **Pipeline Versioning & Security:** Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using **OpenID Connect (OIDC)**
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of modern data platforms, generative AI, and intelligent automation while collaborating across business and technology teams to shape scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. * Shape enterprise data foundations, analytics architecture, AI/ML enablement, generative AI, knowledge retrieval, and intelligent automation capabilities.

* Lead design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions including generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise AI assistants, knowledge retrieval, intelligent workflow automation, and predictive analytics use cases.
* Establish practical delivery and evaluation patterns for AI solutions from experimentation through production rollout, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

* Deep understanding of cloud data platforms, preferably GCP / BigQuery or equivalent enterprise cloud ecosystems.
* Strong expertise in data architecture, data modelling, semantic design, analytical solution patterns, and governed data foundations.
* Practical experience designing or leading enterprise AI solutions, including generative AI, knowledge retrieval, AI assistants, or ML-enabled decision-support capabilities.
* Ability to balance enterprise data platform thinking with AI solution delivery and business adoption.
* Experience guiding cross-functional teams across architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, security, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, quality, security, responsible AI, and enterprise standards.
* Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and lead through change.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

**Company Description**
-----------------------

**Sectigo** is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world’s largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo’s automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. **Simplicity at Scale.**  
  
How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are looking for a talented Senior Engineering Manager join our growing global team at Sectigo.

The Senior Engineering Manager will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions.  
  
Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

  

* Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai.
* Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
* Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far.
* Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team.
* Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
* Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams.
* Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
* Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on.
* Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans.
* Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration.
* Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
* Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.
* Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering.
* Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions.
* Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

* This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week.
* This individual may manage a team and will be reporting directly to our General Manager, Chennai Center of Excellence.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 55,00,000 LPA and INR 75,00,000 LPA. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or Engineering; platform or vendor certifications (e.g., ServiceNow, cloud platform, or API-management certifications) is strongly recommended.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required.
* Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team.
* Hands-on design and administration of API/integration platforms ServiceNow, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Azure Integration Services, or comparable including workflow, connector, and access design is required.
* Familiarity with the PSA (Professional Services Automation) ecosystem tools like ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, or similar and how MSPs/partners consume vendor integrations through them.
* Integration design fundamentals: API contract design, data mapping and transformation, authentication patterns, and designing clean ownership boundaries and handoffs between systems and teams.
* AI-native, hands-on daily, practical use of AI tools in your own workflow (AI coding assistants, agentic dev tools, AI for documentation/testing), with the disposition to keep learning as the tooling changes, in line with our AI-DLC direction.
* ITSM/ticketing and collaboration tooling ServiceNow (or an equivalent ITSM tool) and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) for engineering workflow, tracking, and documentation.
* Experience operating in environments with formal change management, compliance requirements, and high security standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) directly relevant given Sectigo's security/PKI domain.
* Genuine comfort with ambiguity able to create structure, process, and scope where none exists yet, without needing constant top-down direction.
* Ability to establish priorities and work independently with minimal supervision across time zones, with meaningful overlap with US business hours (e.g., available into the evening IST for standups, architecture reviews, and leadership syncs).
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across time zones, functions, and seniority levels.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* An established practice of using an AI assistant inside your engineering workflow change review, log analysis, documentation drafting.
* Relational databases and reporting/BI tools; directory services and access management (Active Directory or equivalent); general network and security concepts relevant to integration architecture.
* PKI and certificate management particularly relevant given Sectigo's core business.
* Prior experience setting up or leading a team inside a Global Capability Center (GCC) in India.
* Experience with contract-to-hire staffing models specifically in the India market.
* Broader background in cybersecurity or certificate/identity infrastructure.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. title: Vulnerability and Patch Manager
description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As **Vulnerability and Patch Manager**, you will lead the vulnerability intelligence, prioritisation and patch advisory service across the client's server, end-user, network and security device estate, coordinating remediation through the client's operational teams and suppliers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**

* Lead a continuous vulnerability assessment programme, using outputs from the client's vulnerability management platform released through the UK service boundary.
* Prioritise vulnerabilities using threat-informed criteria (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, NCSC advisories and vendor PSIRTs) and produce monthly remediation recommendations.
* Issue critical patch advisories, typically within 24 hours, based on client guidance and credible threat intelligence, to enable expedited remediation by UK-based personnel and client suppliers.
* Produce a monthly report on vendor patch and firmware releases across the server, end-user, mobile, network and security estate.
* Produce OS patch and device firmware compliance reports.
* Consolidate patch and upgrade status reporting for firewalls, intrusion prevention, email gateway, secure web gateway and application control platforms.
* Track intrusion prevention signature (digital vaccine) compliance against the 48-hour target, working with the Security Engineer | Network.
* Maintain the vulnerability exception and risk acceptance register and present items for decision through service governance.
* Prepare and co-facilitate the monthly vulnerability and patch review with the UK Head of Service, client teams and third-party suppliers.
* Carry out targeted vulnerability analysis in support of incidents and investigations when directed.
* Apply safe practice for operational technology (OT) assets, where scanning and patching are constrained.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing and technical contribution.

Qualifications:

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vulnerability management vendor certification, e.g. Rapid7, Tenable or Qualys (at least one required).
* CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, GIAC GEVA, or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.

Essential skills:

* Vulnerability management platforms (e.g. Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys) and interpretation of their outputs.
* Patch management processes and tooling (e.g. Intune/MECM, Ivanti, Tanium, BigFix).
* Threat-informed prioritisation using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and vendor advisories.
* Coordinating remediation across internal teams and third-party suppliers.
* Strong reporting and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
* Clear, concise written advisories for technical and non-technical audiences.

Desired skills:

* OT vulnerability management and safe scanning practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Experience supporting NIS or CAF-aligned assurance reporting.

Experience:

* 8-12 years in IT security or infrastructure, including 4+ years managing vulnerability and patch management programmes.
* Experience running risk exception and acceptance processes through governance.

What do I need before I apply:

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening *(equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard)* and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

Benefits:

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits *[India HR to confirm the benefits package].*
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”

If you are an experienced vulnerability management professional who can turn vulnerability data into clear, prioritised action, we encourage you to apply today.
