**Job Title:** Senior Service Engineer – Data Centre (HVAC & Chiller Systems)
  
**Location:** Mumbai/Navi Mumbai
  
**Department:** Service / Data Centre Operations
  
**Reports To:** Data centre Manager ( India)

**Job Summary**
  
The Senior Service Engineer will be responsible for service, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chiller systems in data centre environments. The role also includes supporting and executing data centre HVAC projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, and seamless customer communication. This position requires deep technical expertise in chiller operations, system optimization, and data centre cooling infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**
  
• Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  
• Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  
• Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  
• Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  
• Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing data centre cooling infrastructure.
  
• Review technical drawings, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  
• Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all equipment.
  
• Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer operational protocols.
  
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  
• Interface with customers regularly to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure completion of service and project tasks.
  
• Participate in root‑cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
  
• Coordinate with internal teams (sales, project management, engineering) for seamless service and project delivery.

* Timely submission of Root cause analysis & 8D reports to customers

* Monthly MOR, Quarterly QBR meetings required to be attended with DC customers

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
  
• Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or relevant technical field.
  
• 5–10 years of hands-on experience servicing Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, preferably in data centre applications.
  
• Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  
• Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC equipment.
  
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.
  
• Proficient in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control faults using service tools and diagnostic software.
  
• Strong customer communication skills and ability to work in critical data centre environments.
  
• Familiarity with safety standards and industry best practices.
  
• Good problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications**
  
• Experience with mission‑critical data centres or large industrial cooling systems.
  
• OEM-specific chiller training or certifications (e.g., Trane, Carrier, Daikin).
  
• Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system performance optimization.
  
• Project management experience or certification is a plus.

title: AI Agentic Platform Engineer
description:
Data & AIHybridFull-timeID: REQ-43683

N2P Systems

Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India 3-5 years Posted 2 weeks ago

  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for an AI Agentic Platform Engineer to build scalable, production-ready infrastructure for LLM and multi-agent systems. This role combines agentic AI engineering with cloud-native platform engineering, distributed systems, MLOps/LLMOps, production AI infrastructure, security, and observability. The engineer will help build the foundational platform capabilities required to develop, deploy, operate, and scale AI-agent applications in production.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build and maintain production-grade agentic AI platforms using LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar orchestration frameworks.
* Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to connect AI agents with tools, services, and external APIs.
* Design and implement agent memory solutions using vector databases, semantic caching, and Knowledge Graphs.
* Build scalable cloud-native infrastructure using Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and serverless technologies.
* Develop and optimize model-serving infrastructure using technologies such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama, including GPU resource allocation and batching.
* Build production-grade platform services using Python, Go, or Rust.
* Implement AgentOps, evaluation, tracing, monitoring, and observability for AI systems.
* Build secure execution environments and implement AI guardrails, RBAC, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls, and safety mechanisms.
* Implement dynamic model routing and fallback mechanisms to optimize cost, performance, and latency.
* Develop internal SDKs, CLI utilities, templates, and APIs to support AI application development.
* Collaborate with AI/ML and engineering teams to establish reliable, scalable, and reusable platform capabilities.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* 3+ years of backend or platform engineering experience, including at least 1+ year building production-grade LLM or agent-driven systems.
* Strong experience in Platform Engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, DevOps/SRE, or Microservices Architecture.
* Hands-on experience with production AI/LLM infrastructure and scalable cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native infrastructure, distributed systems, containerization, and production platform engineering.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Educational background from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 engineering institution, with institutions such as IITs, NITs, BITS, or comparable nationally recognized engineering institutes preferred/expected.
* Strong engineering fundamentals with experience building and operating production systems rather than only academic or prototype-level AI projects.
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama for production model serving.
* Proficiency in Python, Go, or Rust for production platform services.
* Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, or Knowledge Graphs for AI memory and retrieval architectures.
* Familiarity with LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Ragas, DeepEval, or Braintrust.
* Experience with Firecracker, gVisor, or WASM-based secure execution environments.
* Knowledge of NeMo Guardrails or Guardrails AI.
* Experience implementing GPU scheduling, batching, model routing, evaluation pipelines, or AI safety controls.

**Role Pre-Screening Criteria**
-------------------------------

Applicants will be asked to answer the following qualifying questions when applying for this position:

* 1Do you have 3+ years of backend/platform engineering experience, including 1+ year building production LLM or agent-driven systems?

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a Senior Engineer I – Validation for Microchip’s MCU division to support validation and characterization of 8, 16 and 32- bit microcontrollers.

Microchip is a world leader in 8, 16, and 32- bit microcontrollers. The Validation Engineer position is focused on helping with development of our digital and parametric testing infrastructure. Significant time will be spent developing test cases, performing lab bench experiments, and assisting other team members in the validation of 8, 16 and 32- bit microcontrollers at unit and system-level. This position is based in Bangalore or Chennai, India. As a Validation Engineer, you will work with worldwide teams located in France, USA, Philippines, India and other corporate team members.

  

* Develop and implement functional, performance and system level/use-case validation of 8, 16 and 32- bit microcontrollers
* Experience with Microcontrollers, FPGAs, and in general, Embedded Systems. Familiar with embedded ARM Cortex M family, RISC-V, MIPS is preferred
* Experience with communication buses (SPI/QSPI, I2C, I2S, USB, EBI, Ethernet, GPIB, RS-232, RS-485, etc.).
* Experience with Embedded firmware development and should have strong hands-on knowledge of Embedded C programming language
* Candidate will have the primary role of creating, auditing, and overseeing test procedures, validation plans, data collection, post-processing of validation data, reports, and documenting results.
* Candidate should be familiar with using lab equipment such as Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, Power Supplies, Arbitrary Waveform and Pulse generators, etc.
* Proficient in interpreting PCB schematics and PCB layouts.
* Develop performance tests for determining circuit margin and datasheet parameters.

title: Advanced Associate, Cloud Services Engineer
description:
**Advanced Associate, Cloud Service Engineer**

**Location:** Chennai, India (Hybrid)

**Team:** Atlassian Administration & Engineering

**Experience:** 2+ years in Atlassian administration or a related platform engineering role

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Atlassian engineer with a few years of experience to join our Atlassian Administration & Engineering team. You’ll work with a team of seven engineers who support a global Atlassian Cloud platform used by about 10,000–12,000 people around the world, across Jira, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery (JPD), and Jira Service Management (JSM).

We recently finished a large migration to Atlassian Cloud, and we’re still bringing separate product instances together into one environment. The migration moved fast and left technical debt behind, so we’re now focused on cleanup: removing legacy customizations and making the platform match Atlassian Cloud best practices. You’ll own parts of that work yourself. That means spotting problems, proposing fixes, and building automation that keeps the platform clean and scalable.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Platform administration:** Take ownership of administration across Jira, Confluence, JPD, and JSM, including permissions, schemes, workflows, custom fields, and space and project configuration.
* **User lifecycle automation:** Design and maintain automated onboarding and offboarding, group management, and license management, working with identity providers and SCIM provisioning.
* **Space and project lifecycle:** Build repeatable, automated processes to create, standardize, and archive projects and spaces at scale.
* **Reduce legacy customizations:** Audit the environment for redundant custom fields, workflows, schemes, and app dependencies. Then propose and carry out plans to remove or consolidate them, using automation wherever possible.
* **Automation engineering:** Build and maintain Atlassian Automation rules for routine and bulk administrative work. Where built-in features fall short, design robust API-driven automation.
* **Engineering practices:** Treat platform automation as production code. Changes are peer-reviewed, tested, and released through a pipeline, not run ad hoc.
* **AI-assisted engineering:** Make AI part of your everyday workflow, from drafting scripts and analyzing configurations to writing documentation, so you deliver more without lowering the quality bar.
* **Service metrics and observability:** Capture service metrics through the Atlassian APIs, store them outside the platform, and build dashboards that show how the service is used and how it’s performing.
* **Solution evaluation:** Weigh built-in Atlassian features against custom or external solutions, and explain clearly why the chosen option is the best fit.
* **Continuous improvement:** Challenge processes that are overly complex, costly, or full of manual toil, and propose simpler, automated alternatives.
* **Best practices and governance:** Help define standards, naming conventions, and configuration guidelines for each product, and document them.
* **Instance consolidation:** Contribute to ongoing migration and consolidation work, including planning, data validation, and post-migration cleanup.
* **Escalations and mentoring:** Resolve complex platform issues, and share knowledge with less experienced teammates and stakeholders.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required:**

* 2+ years of hands-on administration of Jira and/or Confluence, preferably in Atlassian Cloud
* Working experience with Atlassian Automation, including building and troubleshooting rules
* Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or a similar language, and experience building automation against REST APIs (including JSON, authentication, pagination, and rate limits)
* Hands-on experience with Git and version-controlled code or configuration, plus a working understanding of CI/CD practices: build, test, release, versioning, and branching strategies
* Daily, effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude, with the judgment to validate, refine, or reject what they produce
* A solid understanding of Jira configuration: schemes, workflows, screens, fields, and permissions
* Experience managing users and groups at scale in Atlassian Admin
* The ability to analyze an existing configuration, recommend simplifications, and explain the trade-offs clearly
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with stakeholders around the world
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience

**Nice to have:**

* Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-620, or Cloud Organization Admin)
* Experience with AWS services (such as Timestream, Lambda, or S3) and with dashboards in Grafana or similar tools
* Experience administering JSM (request types, queues, SLAs, portals) or JPD
* Experience with identity integration such as Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID, SAML SSO, or SCIM
* Migration experience with JCMA/CCMA or instance merges
* Experience with ScriptRunner or other marketplace apps, and with assessing app usage

**What You’ll Gain**

* Ownership of meaningful parts of a large, enterprise-scale Atlassian Cloud platform
* Real influence over how a global platform is standardized and modernized
* A clear growth path to Specialist and Advanced Specialist roles on the Atlassian Platform Engineering team
* Support for Atlassian certifications and ongoing learning

• Take on Chapter Leadership as an active practitioner in the craft of the Chapter that they lead, i.e., has full accountability to the growth of the Chapter, and not solely a line management responsibility.

• Ensure engineering teams adhere to craftsmanship principles and maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and design
  
• Optimizes AI knowledge reuse and consumption by identifying reusable capabilities and uplifting engineering skills across the hive.

**Risk Management**  
• Identify, manage, and mitigate delivery risks and issues proactively, ensuring timely escalation and resolution
  
• Ensure squads adopt appropriate testing, code reviews, security controls, and architecture governance practices
  
• Maintain strict adherence to eSDLC processes, ensuring high-quality engineering outputs and predictable delivery

• Address tech compliance (ESDLC) requirements through the delivery lifecycle (design reviews, security reviews, SAT, OAT, etc.) with support from HTL(Hive Tech Lead) / PO / CPO (Chief Product Owner)
  
• Ensure compliance with regulatory, operational, and enterprise governance standards across all engineering work
  
• Support audits, oversight reviews, and risk committees with accurate and timely reporting
  
• Drive adherence to engineering governance frameworks, including architecture governance, risk controls, security requirements, and delivery standards
  
• Contribute to and participate in governance forums to represent engineering delivery health, risks, and strategic needs
  
• Evaluates & refines AI-generated requirements / technical artefacts, ensuring strategic alignment, feasibility, & adherence to standards.

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* 10+ years experinece in software engineering
* **Java & Back-end Engineering** Strong hands-on Java engineering experience, with a solid understanding of modern Java, Spring/Spring Boot, concurrency, application performance, dependency management, and building maintainable enterprise back-end services.
* **API & Service Development** Strong experience designing, building and evolving REST APIs and service-based architectures. Able to make good decisions around API contracts, versioning, authentication and authorisation, error handling, idempotency, resilience, observability and backward compatibility.
* **Database Engineering** Strong relational database fundamentals, including data modelling, SQL, transactions, indexing, query optimisation and performance troubleshooting. Experience with PostgreSQL and/or Oracle is preferred, but strong experience with comparable enterprise relational databases is acceptable.
* **Systems Design & Architecture** Able to design scalable, resilient and secure distributed systems, and reason about service boundaries, integration patterns, synchronous versus asynchronous processing, caching, failure handling, high availability and performance.
* **Security Engineering Fundamentals** Strong understanding of secure application development, particularly API security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, secrets management, dependency vulnerabilities and common application/API security risks such as the OWASP Top 10.
* **Engineering Quality & Testing** Strong understanding of automated testing across unit, integration, contract and end-to-end levels, with the ability to establish appropriate quality controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* **DevOps & Production Engineering** Practical experience with CI/CD, containers, deployment automation, monitoring, logging and troubleshooting production services. Able to design software with operability and production resilience in mind.
* **AI-Augmented Engineering & Problem Solving** Able to use AI-assisted engineering tools effectively for software development, analysis, troubleshooting, testing and documentation. Understands prompt and context engineering sufficiently to provide AI tools with the right code, architecture, constraints and engineering context, while critically validating their output.
* **Critical Technical Thinking** Able to challenge assumptions, work through ambiguous technical problems, evaluate alternative approaches and make sound engineering decisions based on evidence, risk and trade-offs.

* Containerisation and Kubernetes
* Cloud-native engineering
* Observability and application performance management

**Job Summary**
---------------

A Data Analyst interprets data and helps turn it into information that enables or improves a business process, thus affecting business decisions. Data Analysts gather information from various sources and interpret patterns and trends to make it digestible for others. They must have strong analytical skills, but above all have a burning curiosity to understand, and make sense of, data. They will work closely with:
  
• Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities
  
• Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated
  
• Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health
  
• Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing
  
• Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function
  
Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place. Data Analysts are the entry point to the FCC Data Team for most external stakeholders and as such will have a broad, but still detailed, understanding of all the data available and constantly seek opportunities for innovation and expansion. They are the primary liaison between up- and downstream teams

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Responsibilities for FCC Data Analysts:**  
• Define clear, concise and detailed business requirements for FCC Data that clearly document the data elements and formats that are needed, outline detailed transformation expectations and list the critical data elements that will enable downstream processes to operate effectively
  
• Create and maintain documentation that articulates the process by which data is extracted, transformed and loaded in FCC that can be shared and understood by others
  
• Work with downstream FCC business process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the datasets to improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI
  
• Conduct detailed analysis of upstream changes that impact FCC data – for example the introduction of a new products – to ensure that requirements remain up to date and define any new ones as necessary
  
• Identify areas of overlap or data gaps that can lead to increased value, either by eliminating redundant processes or expanding existing data models
  
• Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
• SQL Querying skills
  
• Payments knowledge of Swift network and ISO 20022
  
• Banking domain knowledge
  
**Other Skills**  
• AML knowledge
  
• Interpersonal skills
  
• Stakeholder Management

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Skills and Eligibility**  
• Minimum 10+ years of professional experience as business change analyst in financial markets related banking products
  
• Degree (or similar) in Engineering and MBA is preferred
  
• A strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Good understanding of systems and data flows in Financial Crime Compliance / Anti Money Laundering etc. will be an added advantage
  
• Able to seamlessly move and translate between detailed functional data requirements and non-technical general terms
  
• The ability to write clear, concise and detailed business requirements that can be understood by data engineers and developers as well as business stakeholders
  
• Strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Competence with data profiling tools and methodologies (SQL at a minimum), with a preference for dedicated and sophisticated tools such as Paxata or Tableau
  
• Familiar with data documentation, delivery workflow and defect tracking tools – JIRA and Confluence in particular
  
• Demonstrated experience in handling and understanding large datasets and relational databases
  
• Experience in analytical roles with a large technical component, although not necessarily from a purely data perspective (e.g. they may have prior working knowledge of upstream or downstream processes that is relevant from a data perspective)
  
• Evidenced ability to execute and enhance a process to maintain data transformation requirements over time and constantly seek to improve these
  
• High quality written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to focus on multiple initiatives and data subjects (types of data or varying sources of data) at the same time
  
• Evidence a very strong attention to detail, reflecting the very low tolerance for error in FCC data

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together we:

* **Do the right thing** and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* **Never settle,** continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* **Are better together,** we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What we offer**
-----------------

**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance,** with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time-off** including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* **Flexible working** options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.

 **Job Description**

**Role Summary:**

The Engineer III is an experienced individual contributor who independently designs, develops, implements, and supports secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable enterprise integration solutions. The role combines strong EDI and API engineering capabilities with technical ownership across middleware, messaging, file-based interfaces, automation, modernization, and platform services. The Engineer III consistently delivers high-quality work, contributes to technical decisions and design reviews, guides peers and junior engineers, and helps shape solutions across systems, services, platforms, and products within the assigned domain.

Working across engineering teams and business stakeholders, the Engineer III drives complex integration delivery, strengthens operational resilience, improves code quality and performance, promotes engineering standards, and translates business and customer needs into effective technical solutions. The role also contributes through mentoring, knowledge sharing, documentation, continuous improvement, and portfolio or department-level initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Software, API, and Platform Development**

* Design, develop, configure, test, implement, and support application components, services, APIs, EDI translations, middleware integrations, and platform capabilities.
* Independently develop and maintain REST-based APIs, web services, system interfaces, reusable components, and automation utilities using established engineering standards and architectural patterns.
* Perform thorough self-reviews and code reviews, provide actionable feedback to peers and junior engineers, and improve the maintainability, reliability, security, and performance of solutions.
* Develop and maintain automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, API, and end-to-end test coverage to improve software quality and reliability
* Optimize complex code, mapping logic, services, and integration flows to reduce processing time, resource usage, defects, and repeated implementation effort.
* Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to support coding, testing, documentation, defect detection, and technical analysis while maintaining established quality and security standards.

**EDI and Enterprise Integration Delivery**

* Design, develop, and support enterprise integrations across ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML, JSON, CSV, flat files, APIs, middleware, messaging, event-driven communication, and managed file-transfer patterns.
* Own complex EDI and integration projects, including requirement interpretation, mapping and transformation logic, interface design, validation, testing, implementation, deployment, and post-production support.
* Analyze input and output data, envelopes, acknowledgements, partner configurations, routes, canonical structures, and downstream system behavior to confirm accuracy, completeness, and expected processing.
* Troubleshoot complex applications, API, middleware, mapping, dataflow, transactions, communication, and performance issues by isolating root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and downstream impacts early, and recommend mitigation approaches for complex or cross-system changes.
* Contribute reusable integration patterns, utilities, templates, and documentation that improve quality and consistency, acceleratetime to market, and strengthen team effectiveness.

**API Engineering and Modernization**

* Design, consume, test, secure, document, and support REST APIs and related system interfaces, including API contracts, request and response structures, validation, error handling, and versioning considerations.
* Contribute to API enablement that complements EDI capabilities and supports modern, reusable, and self-service integration experiences where appropriate.
* Apply microservices, messaging, event-driven, distributed system, and domain-driven design concepts to assign solutions when applicable.
* Contribute to application modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy platforms to modern architecture and engineering practices.
* Collaborate with platform, architecture, security, product, and adjacent engineering teams to align API and integration solutions with enterprise patterns and strategic objectives.

**Technical Design and Architecture**

* Lead or actively contribute to technical design for systems of significant size and near- to mid-term business impact.
* Participate actively in technical design reviews, provide feedback on other designs, incorporate feedback, and help shape technical decisions of significant complexity, ensuring alignment with Engineering Principles and architectural standards.
* Apply Engineering Principles and approved architectural patterns to improve modularity, interoperability, reliability, scalability, maintainability, security, and observability.
* Evaluate system dependencies, design tradeoffs, operational impacts, failure modes, and downstream effects when developing or changing solutions.
* Document technical designs, API contracts, data mappings, implementation decisions, test evidence, deployment details, operational procedures, and support findings.

**Engineering Practices and Operational Excellence**

* Own technical decisions for daily work and ensure conformity to Engineering Principles, coding standards, development processes, security practices, and deployment procedures.
* Actively enable Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery through automated builds, testing, quality checks, and deployment practices.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, telemetry, logging, alerting, and operational automation capabilities to improve system resilience and operational excellence**.**
* Participate in production support and on-call rotations; guide operational resilience for systems contributed to and engage effectively in incident management and response.
* Contribute to operational and security automation and identify recurring support or delivery activities that can be simplified or automated.
* Continuously improve code quality, system performance, delivery efficiency, and customer experience through root-cause analysis and preventive action.

  
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of professional experience in software development, application integration, platform support, API development, middleware, or related engineering discipline
* Progressive experience in software development, enterprise application integration, API development, EDI, middleware, platform engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Experience independently delivering complex integration solutions and contributing to technical design and solution architecture decisions.
* Experience developing and supporting production integrations, participating in incident response and operational support, and improving system resilience.
* Experience performing code and design reviews, providing technical feedback, and mentoring less experienced engineers.
* Experience collaborating across teams to deliver technology solutions and business outcomes using agile delivery, source control, testing, and modern engineering workflows.

To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.

* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles

* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.

title: Data Capability Engineer
description:
**Job title:** Data Capability Engineer**Location:** Chennai**Reports to:** IT Systems Architecture**Contract:** Permanent, Full\-time **Purpose of the Role:**
Own and extend the accuracy, completeness, and usability of the service management platform's data — so implementation teams and AI\-driven capabilities can act on it directly, and so priority consumers like vulnerability and exposure management run on complete, trustworthy ground truth. Service mapping and asset data are the anchor domain and immediate priority; the durable mandate is data quality across an increasingly AI\-centric ITSM platform, where automated systems act on data without a human to catch errors first.  

**A data\-capability role, not a security role.** **Core responsibilities — Anchor domain: Service \& asset data (immediate priority)**  

* Ensure existing service mapping is accurate and current across hosts, servers, and applications.
* Extend mapping coverage to data types not well covered today — certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS applications.
* Engage in the workflows that onboard new applications and capabilities into the CMDB so coverage keeps pace rather than drifting.
* Go deeper into discovery and software\-asset tooling — Lansweeper, the software asset management system, and agent\-based discovery — to raise inventory fidelity.
 **Core responsibilities — Broader mandate: Platform \& AI\-consumption data quality**  

* Apply the same discipline to other high\-value platform data — service catalog and metadata, ticket routing and assignment\-group data, and the Dataverse structures underneath delivery capabilities such as the AskIT service chatbot.
* Raise data to the standard AI systems require: complete, disambiguated, and semantically clean, so intent classification, catalog matching, and automated routing act on trustworthy inputs rather than amplifying noise.
* Leverage the existing foundation (Dataverse schema, discovery tooling, search indexes already in place) rather than building net\-new infrastructure.
* Make data consumable without re\-verification \- the test is whether an engineer or an automated agent can act on a record without re\-checking it, and turn recurring data problems into repeatable quality practices.
 **What this role is not**  

* **Not remediation coordination or change management**
* **Not a security function \-** it supplies the data; it does not own security decisions.
* **Not a net\-new platform build \-** leverages and improves the existing foundation.
 **Example Success measures**  

* **Coverage:** % of assets, certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS apps mapped to owner and service; extended over time to other platform data domains.
* **Data confidence:** high enough that implementation teams and AI capabilities don't require re\-verification.
* **Time\-to\-onboard** a new application or capability into the CMDB.
* **Reusability:** improvements delivered as repeatable practices, not one\-off fixes.
 **What You’ll Need:****Education:**  

Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, data management, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. A candidate with a strong track record in CMDB, discovery, or data\-quality work should not be screened out for lack of the exact degree. **Experience:**  

Five to eight years in IT data, configuration/asset management, or a data\-engineering\-adjacent role, including demonstrable ownership of a data domain (not just contributing to one). Enough experience to set the standard for how data quality is done, with the judgment to work independently under a Senior Manager's direction rather than needing task\-level supervision. **Required skills and knowledge**  

**Anchor domain — asset \& service data**  

* Hands\-on experience with CMDB and service mapping concepts (configuration items, relationships, service dependencies), including keeping mapping accurate as the environment changes.
* Working knowledge of discovery and software\-asset tooling — Lansweeper, agent\-based discovery, and a software asset management system — and what drives inventory fidelity in each.
* Understanding of the asset types the role must extend into: certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS applications.
 **Broader mandate — platform \& AI\-consumption data quality**  

* Strong data\-quality fundamentals: profiling, deduplication, normalization, and defining and measuring completeness and accuracy.
* Practical experience querying and shaping data in a structured platform (Dataverse or a comparable relational/low\-code data platform), working with existing schema rather than designing greenfield systems.
* Query capability sufficient to investigate, validate, and correct data at scale independently.
* Familiarity with what makes data consumable by AI systems — why completeness, disambiguation, and clean semantics matter for intent classification, matching, and routing. Deep machine\-learning expertise is not required; the relevant skill is data readiness, not model building.
 **Ways of working**  

* Able to embed quality into existing onboarding workflows and turn recurring problems into repeatable practices, rather than one\-off fixes.
* Communicates data issues and their business impact clearly to both technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders.
 **Your Advantage:*** Experience in a Microsoft Power Platform environment (Power Automate, Azure AI Search, or similar).
* Exposure to vulnerability or exposure management as a data consumer — understanding what that function needs from asset data, without owning the security decisions.
* ITIL familiarity (service management context), or a data\-management certification (e.g., DAMA/CDMP).

In this role, you will be the technical authority for our core data stack—leveraging Azure as our cloud backbone, Snowflake for data warehousing, and dbt (data build tool) for transformations and data modeling. Design and execute a scalable, cost\-efficient ELT architecture using Azure Data Factory/Event Hubs, Snowflake, and dbt Cloud/Core.


Establish medallion architecture standards (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers) or Kimball dimensional modeling across raw, transformed, and analytics\-ready marts.


Drive platform performance tuning, capacity planning, resource monitoring, and Snowflake warehouse cost optimization (FinOps).


2\. Core Pipeline Engineering \& Transformation


Develop modular, reusable, and tested dbt models using advanced features (macros, packages, custom materializations, state\-based incremental loads).


Configure ingestion pipelines from Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2\) into Snowflake via Azure Event Grid, Snowpipe, or Auto\-ingest tasks.


Extend ELT capabilities using Python/Snowpark for unstructured data processing and complex transformations.


3\. Data Engineering Best Practices \& DevOps


Implement continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions for dbt code deployment and Snowflake zero\-downtime schema migrations.


Establish automated data quality testing, lineage, and documentation via dbt tests, Great Expectations, or integrated observability platforms (e.g., Monte Carlo).


Enforce security and governance standards: Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) in Snowflake, dynamic data masking, row\-level security, and PII protection.


4\. Leadership \& Stakeholder Collaboration


Lead and mentor a team of 4–8 Data Engineers through code reviews, architectural blueprints, and agile execution.


Collaborate with Data Architects, Analytics Engineers, BI Leads, and Business Stakeholders to translate analytics needs into robust data platform features.

Demonstrated experience with CI/CD tools (Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps) and infrastructure automation.

Azure, ADF, snowflake, DBT, fivetran, SQL, Python, Pyspark, ETL

Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. GIS develops the bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, identifies and addresses vulnerabilities and operates a global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents. Within GIS, the Cloud Security organization is responsible for leading a team of deeply technical cyber security engineers and architects to design and implement best in class cyber security capabilities for internal and external cloud instances in partnership with infrastructure and application technology teams. In addition, lead efforts across other Global Information Security functions to enable cyber security technology and operations in cloud environments.


**Job Description**


This role involves specialization in Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) technologies with strong understanding of cloud security architecture, IAM protocols, authentication mechanisms, and role\-based access control. Responsible for components of complex engineering and/or analytical tasks and activities. * Designing, implementing, and managing IAM solutions in cloud environments
* Strong understanding of cloud security architecture, IAM protocols, authentication mechanisms, and role\-based access control
* Problem\-solving skills and the ability to analyze complex technical issues and provide effective solutions
* Collaborate across departments and present complex security concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

**Education :** B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech


**Certifications If Any** : CCSP Certification, Cloud Security Certifications from AWS


**Experience Range :** 8 \- 10 years


**Foundational skills**


* Experience in writing Terraform configurations and modules
* Hands\-on experiences in coding
* Experience in Cloud IAM, network and Security design
* Advance knowledge of Single\-Sign On (SSO), Federated Identities, AWS Identity Center and AWS IAM
* Hands\-on experience with design and implement cloud security architecture
* Implement strong Identity Management and Access control policies for cloud access
* Private Cloud and Public cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS Cloud
* Monitor cloud environment for security threats and integrate with incident response
* Experience in CI/ CD for cloud via pipelines
* Good knowledge of AWS bedrock and AWS STS services
* Experience in Dev SecOps model with infra\-as\-code, config\-as\-code, policy\-as\-code etc
* Knowledge of current and upcoming cloud security/network technologies (e.g IPS, DDoS, SIEM, WAF etc) and understanding of compliance and regulatory standards
* Understanding of landing zones, cloud native security, monitoring and logging tools like Splunk, Cloud Trail, Cloud Watch etc.
* Knowledge of common Information Security frameworks, relevant legal \& regulatory requirements like NIST Cybersecurity, CIS controls, SOX and Data Security standard
* Knowledge of cloud network design and deployment architecture
* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to make effective presentations and communicate technical concepts to non\-technical parties
* Excellent communication, influencing and facilitation skills with deep intellectual curiosity and innovative thinker
* Demonstrate neutral objectivity and seek the best outcome for the business. Enterprise mindset; considers E2E process impact when evaluating opportunities/challenges
* Maximizes organizational capability with a demonstrated commitment to valuing diversity

**Desired skills**

* Understanding of API design concepts, RESTful Services and modern application interaction patterns


* Familiarity with IT security and risk management practices

**Job Description:**


**About Us**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.


In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.


**Process Overview**


Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. GIS develops the bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, identifies and addresses vulnerabilities and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents. Within GIS, the Cloud Security organization is responsible for leading a team of deeply technical cyber security engineers and architects to design and implement best in class cyber security capabilities for internal and external cloud instances in partnership with infrastructure and application technology teams. In addition, lead efforts across other Global Information Security functions to enable cyber security technology and operations in cloud environments.


**Job Description**


This role is for GIS Penetration testing team to conduct penetration tests and source code reviews of our internal/external web, mobile, web, and web API service applications, leveraging both manual techniques as well as automated tools to uncover and report security vulnerabilities that exist.
  

  

You must be knowledgeable with business risks associated to common security vulnerabilities and to be able to effectively communicate complex technical concepts such as security vulnerabilities to application developers and/or senior managers who may have little to no experience with application security.
  

  

You must have the ability to work independently in a very large scale, enterprise setting and collaborate with peer team members. Previous experience as an application security professional with a large Financial Institution a plus.


**Responsibilities**


* Performs assigned analysis of internal and external threats on information systems and predict future threat behavior
* Incorporates threat actors' tactics, techniques, and procedures into offensive security testing
* Performs assessments of the security, effectiveness, and practicality of multiple technology systems
* Leverages innovative thinking to help solve problems or introduce new ideas to processes or products applicable to offensive security
* Prepares and presents detailed technical information for various media including documents, reports, and notifications
* Provides clear and practical advice regarding managed risks
* Learns and develops advanced technical and leadership skills; Mentor Junior assessors in technical tradecraft and soft skill

**Requirements**


**Education:** B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech


**Certifications, If Any:** GWAPT, CEH, OSCP, SANS, CEH


**Experience Range:** 6\+ years


**Foundational Skills:**


* Strong hands\-on experience in conducting comprehensive manual penetration tests and source code reviews against web, API, mobile applications, services, platforms, systems, and networks to identify security vulnerabilities.
* Solid experience in using various security tools such as Invicti, SoapUI, Burp Suite Pro, Checkmarx, Kali Linux, Metasploit, etc.
* Very Good Communication \& Interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of network and Web related protocols/technologies.
* Experience with latest penetration testing techniques (e.g., web application proxies, packet capture analysis software, browser extensions, advanced penetration testing tools (full stack), Linux distributions, Windows OS, etc.).
* Experience of penetration testing on mobile platforms such as iOS, Android, and mobile device simulators.
* Solid programming/debugging skills with proficiency in one or more of the following: Java, JavaScript, HTML, XML, PHP, ASP.NET, AJAX, JSON, Python, Perl, Shell script, Objective\-C, and SOAP/REST web APIs.
* Expert\-level experience and knowledge in the following areas:


	+ Authentication and security protocols.
	+ Application session management.
	+ Applied cryptography.
	+ Common communication protocols.
	+ Mobile frameworks.
	+ Single sign\-on technologies.
	+ Development frameworks (Angular, React, etc.).
	+ Exploit automation platforms.
* Knowledge of a Structured Query Language.
* Developer experience or coding background (nice\-to\-have).

**Desired Skills:**


* Experience of penetration testing and source code reviews on web, API and mobile platforms.
* Solid programming/debugging skills with proficiency in one or more of the following: Java, JavaScript, HTML, XML, PHP, ASP.NET, AJAX, JSON, Objective\-C, and SOAP/REST web APIs.

**Work Timings:** 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM

* Experience developing large\-scale SQL data transformation solutions.

* Experience implementing indexing strategies and database performance tuning.

The unit manages and modernizes enterprise data and analytics platforms including SAP BW, SAP Business Objects, Azure\-based data platforms, and reporting solutions while supporting strategic initiatives related to data modernization, cloud adoption, operational reporting, compliance, and financial transparency. **Duties and Accountabilities** **Role Purpose**  

The Platform Engineer (SAP BW \& Data Platform) is responsible for the engineering, administration, modernization, and operational excellence of the World Bank Group's enterprise analytics and data platforms.  

The role supports SAP BW on HANA, Business Objects, SAP data integration technologies, Azure\-based data platforms, and enterprise reporting solutions. The Platform Engineer collaborates with product owners, architects, data engineers, business stakeholders, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform reliability, performance, scalability, security, governance, and continuous improvement.  

The position contributes to the evolution of enterprise analytics capabilities through automation, modernization initiatives, cloud adoption, DevOps practices, observability, and platform engineering principles, enabling trusted and timely business insights across financial and operational domains. **Key Responsibilities** **SAP BW Platform Engineering*** Administer, maintain, and optimize SAP BW on HANA environments.
* Manage platform upgrades, patches, transport, performance tuning, and capacity planning.
* Support business\-critical financial and operational reporting processes.
* Ensure platform availability, resiliency, scalability, and operational stability.
* Support BW upgrade, modernization and migration initiatives, including cloud and next\-generation analytics platforms.


 • Perform professional\-level analysis and platform engineering activities across data and analytics platforms.

* Solve moderately complex platforms, integration, performance, and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define solutions and drive continuous improvement.
* Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing within the platform engineering and analytics delivery teams.
* Apply practical expertise across data platforms, analytics architecture, cloud technologies, integration, security, and operational support.

**Integration \& Data Operations*** Manage SAP BW, SAP ECC, SAP BODS, and related enterprise data integrations.
* Support incident response, root cause analysis, and issue remediation activities.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream application teams to ensure reliable data movement and processing.
* Monitor platform health, data loads, and integration performance.

**Analytics \& Reporting Platforms*** Support Business Objects, Power BI, Bex, Analysis for Office and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Ensure reporting platform performance, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Partner with business stakeholders to enable trusted, timely, and scalable reporting capabilities.

 **Security, Risk \& Compliance*** Ensure compliance with World Bank security, audit, data governance, and operational risk requirements.
* Support security reviews, vulnerability remediation, and platform hardening activities.
* Participate in audit response and compliance remediation efforts.
* Maintain appropriate controls for access management, data protection, and system integrity.

**Agile Delivery \& Collaboration*** Participate in SAFe Agile ceremonies including PI Planning, Iteration Planning, Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Scrum Masters, and Engineering teams to prioritize platform improvements.
* Contribute to backlog refinement and technical roadmap planning.
* Support continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.

**Selection Criteria**

**Education \& Experience*** Master's degree with 5 years of relevant experience or Bachelor's degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience in enterprise data platforms, SAP BW, data engineering, analytics platforms, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale analytics, reporting, and data platforms.
* Experience with SAP BW on HANA administration, development support, and platform operations.
* Experience with enterprise data integration, analytics modernization, and cloud data platform technologies.

**Core Skills and Capabilities**  

Strong expertise in SAP BW on HANA, SAP BODS, data platform engineering, data warehousing, analytics, integration, and enterprise reporting, complemented by hands\-on experience with Azure Databricks and cloud\-based data platforms. Skilled in platform operations, DevOps, database management, security, governance, monitoring, and modern data architecture practices to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure enterprise analytics solutions.
Advanced analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and Agile delivery skills, with the ability to effectively manage stakeholders, influence decisions, and foster collaboration across cross\-functional teams to achieve business and technology objectives.

**Recommended Certifications**  

SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM), SAP BW, Databricks Data Engineer Certification, TOGAF Certification**WBG Culture Attributes:**


1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  

2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  

3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.
